articles.content:
Beard Burn is Lowkey the Modern Day Scarlet Letter

By Anonymous

I liked reading The Scarlet Letter in high school because the idea of Hester Prynne being forced to walk around town with a visible symbol of her sexual promiscuity was a concept entirely divorced from my own existence. Yup, I was the loser virgin with her nose stuffed in a book during lunch hour every day.

But now? It’s not so funny. That scarlet letter is f*cking real and takes the form of a crimson chin. A vermilion cupid’s bow. A cardinal cheek.

If you get down and dirty with a stubbled fellow, the world WILL know for weeks to come. When I showed up for the first week of classes with a particularly concealer-resistant case, I could hear the whispers rippling throughout the lecture hall.

Slut… whore… girl that fucks…

It’s like a hickey but worse. It’s almost entirely unavoidable, unless maybe you wanna smear an obnoxious amount of lube or Vaseline all over your faces first. I haven’t troubleshot that one yet so LMK.

It’s truly a universal issue. “I’m pretty sure my entire chin’s epidermis has been exfoliated off at this point,” said Heather Prin (CAS ‘27).

The Condom Fairy was contacted for an interview but declined to comment on the matter. We also contacted the Vending Machine in the GSU Basement, but it just gave us some beeps and whirrs in response. Not sure if that translates to anything of use— perhaps it’s working on a cure?

BU Medical Campus students have been hard at work in the lab to develop an ointment to strengthen the skin barrier and undo the sandpaper effects of 3-day old stubble. “It’s a phenomenon entirely resistant to every effort we make. We’ve never worked with such a stubborn entity,” said Nar Lee (MED ‘26).

One day, we might be able to love up on less recently-shaven people without being forced to flaunt it for the following weeks to come. In the meantime? Get that Dr. Jart color correcting BB cream and some Neosporin and pray, girl.

articles.title: Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop
articles.description: Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop By Willa Norvell Zuck, Zuck, Zuck… how did we get here? I'll admit, you had me fooled, once upon a time.
articles.content:
Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop

By Willa Norvell

Zuck, Zuck, Zuck… how did we get here? I’ll admit, you had me fooled, once upon a time. When all my friends first downloaded your silly little app and I didn’t know any better. When Jesse Eisenberg and his half Josh O’ Connor half Mike Faist face brought your goofy little Harvard story to life. I trust Jesse, so I said sure. A flick of the wrist and bibbity bobbity boo, Instagram became the belle of the ball in my life.

I can still remember sitting in the seventh grade classroom and feeling the rush of my first post getting four likes. I mean wow, what a time to be young in a world where data privacy didn’t exist. But now the appeal has faded, as most things do, and your pink camera square turned back into a pumpkin just a few weeks ago. I can’t bear it anymore. The Ella Enchanted whiplash of smashing the app every five seconds is exhausting. I’m done. I’m finished.

I’m only using Instagram on my computer.

I have to say, this is about as close to cold turkey as I can get. For one, there is no opening Instagram in class in the chance that my peers will see a Yungblud post or something. Two, I physically am incapable of posting a story because computer IG is extremely underdeveloped. Three, for some reason when I comment on someone else’s stuff, it literally sends them a dm? I am not trying to slide, don’t try to play matchmaker Zuck.

However, the physical media movement is back and I’m proud to be a part of it. So far, all I have been hearing is vinyl this, CD that. To those folks I ask, what do you know about the cold touch of your keyboard as you wind down to a Google Chrome tab? Sure, you can’t take cool photos of yourself looking through albums that you absolutely will not buy. But that’s not the point. The point is that I’m disconnecting myself from convenience in such a spiritual way that I can’t even share it on social media. That’s kinda meta, right? Oop! Meta!

Of course, by the time anyone reads this, I will have certainly redownloaded the app for posting or sharing purposes.
articles.name: Willa Norvell

articles.title: Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case
articles.description: Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case By Lauren Matz Men have been sharing their unsolicited thoughts with humanity since the beginning of time.
articles.content:
Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case

By Lauren Matz

Men have been sharing their unsolicited thoughts with humanity since the beginning of time. Whether it’s standing on a soap box in the middle of the town square or sitting their bitch ass in front of an Audio Technica AT875R, they have a lot to say and they’re gonna make sure you hear it. Did the journal factory blow up? According to men, it was never even built.

I did some looking into male podcasts, and as annoying as they are, you can’t deny their influence. If you give a man a microphone… other men are gonna listen and use it to form an opinion. It’s a classic factor of the manosphere. But here’s a thought: what if we formed an elite taskforce of men to start feeding more… correct information into the minds of young, impressionable boys? Here’s some ideas I lined up:

She Comes First: Named after the book, this podcast covers all things Female Pleasure. Since men don’t really read, let’s put it in podcast form for them and hope less women have to suffer through Hopeless Desperate Male Fumbling down there. Listeners can submit new tips and tricks they’ve learned for creating a space where their girlfriends can actually enjoy sex. Maybe if it’s a man saying it, other men will finally listen and learn that just hardcore DJ-ing that shit isn’t really all that enjoyable for women. Or maybe some men will just learn the clitoris exists. Either way, there’s potential for major change here.

Axe That Body Spray: The new hit podcast for fans (and noobs) of male hygiene. Listeners can learn that simply dousing their body in a generous helping of Axe Body Spray is not a replacement for a shower. Each week’s episode might cover a new hygiene topic, technique, or tip: for example, if you use a washcloth or loofah to clean your body and not just your bare man hands, you might be on the way to smelling decent! Life changing stuff. Women don’t have to be the only ones that enjoy pampering themselves!

Auth-HER, Direct-HER, Aut-HER: Pronounced Author, Director, Auteur, this podcast is a must-listen for any man new to the world of media made by women. Each week, the hosts cover a new book, movie, or album by a woman and dissect it. The best part– they know when it’s time to shut their mouths and let HER speak! Suggested segments: Listening to Women (reading reviews of the movie/book/album– but ONLY ones written by women), The BOX Office (studies film industry trends from an feminist perspective), and The Bechdel Test (self explanatory). Also, there’s a woman guest every week just to make sure things stay… on track.

Check that E-Male!: Men’s one-stop-shop for learning how to adequately communicate! No more unintelligible mumbles and “k”s, but rather skills to foster some actual meaningful human connection! Listeners can hear about common mistakes men run into when trying and failing to express their feelings and thoughts– AND learn how to do better! And just in case men are simultaneously struggling with LISTENING, the podcast provides 100% accurate transcripts so they can read along and really internalize the message. Men will be speaking like functioning adults in no time!

So. LMK if any of these ideas stand out– I need funding. I really think we can make a difference here! Now, if I can just find some men deserving of the microphone…

articles.title: Observing Lent By Tackling Box On Fridays
articles.description: As we all know, Lent is a solemn observance that mirrors the 40 days and nights our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, spent fasting in the desert, enduring salacious temptations by Satan. As devout Catholics, we must prepare for Easter through a period of repentance, sacrificing earthly pleasures to strengthen our faith in and connection with God.
articles.content:
As we all know, Lent is a solemn observance that mirrors the 40 days and nights our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, spent fasting in the desert, enduring salacious temptations by Satan. As devout Catholics, we must prepare for Easter through a period of repentance, sacrificing earthly pleasures to strengthen our faith in and connection with God.

The three pillars of Lent are prayer, almsgiving, and fasting, and I try very hard to partake. I read the Bible and pray every second I have, in hopes that the Almighty will feel my luscious lips wrapping around his glistening, divine words. I donate every spare penny that comes across my bank account to the local megachurch, so they may build a second waterslide or perhaps a sixth parking lot to amplify the voice of the gospel. After all, “It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God” (Mark 10:25), so g*sh-d*rnit I am going to give those alms!

I must confess, here, though, that I am struggling to fast. Forgive me, DaddyFather, for I have sinned.

Some members of my church are practicing simple living by foregoing animal products entirely, living off the grid, and foraging wild tubers, greens, nuts, and berries to sustain themselves. They only return for service, and I shamefully cannot be within 6 feet of them, as they have not showered since Ash Wednesday and stink like H-E-double hockey sticks. I would normally at least abstain from meat on Fridays, but I need the animal protein for my gains — tofu, beans, and fish won’t cut it.

Others refrain from physical relations, engaging in self-denial and resisting the pleasures of the flesh in the same way Jesus did in his long, hot, thirsty trip through the Judaean Desert with the Devil tempting him at every turn. Which could mean nothing. Unfortunately, there is nothing I love more than mortifying my flesh, if you know what I mean. Pious kneeling at a certain altar is a daily occurrence in my household. Chains and flagellation? Sign me up! I am simply too weak to give up these luxuries.

So I propose a compromise. On Fridays, I will abstain from meat, but in return, I will be permitted to partake in the great tradition of consuming seafood without shame. By this, I mean eating bearded clams. Pearl diving. Licking the beaver. Exploring the coral reef. While you all are busy with teaching a man to fish and feeding him for a lifetime or whatever, I’m spending my time groping for trouts in a peculiar river. Tackling box, if you will.

I would like to end this plea with a prayer, so that we may receive mercy from Christ, our Savior.

Look with favor, Lord,

on your household.

Grant that,

though our flesh be humbled

by abstinence from food,

our souls, hungering after you,

may be resplendent in your sight.

Amen.

articles.title: Enrolled in Trade School… Why Is No One Gay?
articles.description: Look, we all know we're gonna be unemployed within the next five years. It's just a fact.
articles.content:
Look, we all know we’re gonna be unemployed within the next five years. It's just a fact. So yes, I dropped out, sue me. Am I still writing for Pinky? Apparently. So I enrolled in trade school, cause’ can a robot be a plumber? Maybe, but not for the next ten years. Suck on that, losers.

Look, I can weld (maybe I think?? Seriously, it doesn’t look too hard), I don't know. I just enrolled. It can’t be that bad, right?

 Did part of me see the word “Trade” and think “omggg waiiiittttt a school full of DL trade men? And it's not the FTV department in COM? Sign me up.” I was soooo excited y'all I can’t even explain. It's been a hard last few weeks, valentines day and all, and I thought I’d meet someone.

**Also look, the term “trade” was taken from the black queer community and its meaning has been changed by those straight girls who looooove to go to a gay bar and make YOU feel like shit.

The second I step onto the linoleum floors of the entryway, I’m hatecrimed.

Okay so not really but I was just walking to class (Pipefitting 101– guess why I picked it), when I was suddenly knocked into the wall by this dude, spilling my books everywhere.

“What the fuck.”

“I- I’m so sorry” He says, rubbing the back of his neck before frantically collecting the spilled textbooks.

Huh. What a weird interaction.

The second I walked into the room, I knew I’d made the wrong decision. It smelled like onions. Man B.O from years of manual labor coated my nostrils in a putrid patina that still refuses to leave. The air was thick with testosterone and repressed self-loathing.

This was the straightest place I’d ever seen.

Instant fight-or-flight reaction. I turn to leave when the man who’d ran into me shuts the door.

Wait- is he my teacher? Is this some Webtoon or Tumblr bullshit I would’ve thought was a literary masterpiece in middle school? If that’s the case, then there has to be a gay side plot.

Apparently, yes. It is.

Class starts, and I’m actually not half bad at this stuff! The professor goes to assist the guy next to me — his work looks like shit from a butt.

“You just need to relax, Will,” The teacher said, placing his hands on top of his student’s; he was slowly guiding his movements as he worked up and down the pipe. “It’s a tight fit”

Okay now actually what the fuck. That’s freaky, right? That’s a freak thing to say? Maybe I’m the friend that’s too woke. I keep working.

“I-I’m not sure if I can do it,”  the student breathes.

Okay woah. Maybe ts is gay. The teacher is sensually welding like in the movie Ghost. That’s gay as hell!

So maybe this was a love story, just not mine.

I mean, come on. My next class is Woodworking… WOOD! The pieces all start to fit in my mind… maybe these Trade School people are actually Trade School Trade? What if you get Trade School Trade take a trade class? I’m a background character in Trade School Musical 2. I’m Sharpay and they’re about to sing “I Don’t Dance” — the gayest song in the series.

I smiled to myself, knowing I’d found my forever home in a sour-smelling paradise of semi-gay dreams.

Life is good.

  • Finding love?
  • Sensually teaching welding
  • WOODWORKING (tap into itttt)

articles.title: seX-Files: Metrosexual Humanoids
articles.description: seX-Files Agent NEMO COX Case Name: "Metrosexual Humanoids" Case Number: DL-001 Opened: 10.29.25 Closed: 2.28.26 Mission Status: APOCALYPTIC Agent Status: TERMINATED Case Log 10.29.25 It all started with these Arcteryx beanies off the ski slope. That must've been the point of first transmission.
articles.content:
seX-Files

Agent NEMO COX

Case Name: “Metrosexual Humanoids”

Case Number: DL-001

Opened: 10.29.25

Closed: 2.28.26

Mission Status: APOCALYPTIC

Agent Status: TERMINATED

Case Log

10.29.25

It all started with these Arcteryx beanies off the ski slope. That must’ve been the point of first transmission. Too much design for your average John. They started lining Commonwealth Ave like a black and purple river rising. Facial and double ear piercings followed shortly after, paired with totes and rings. Each man seemed to know if they were “gold or silver toned.” I know Boston was a gay man's city——but not a gay man only city. Something is up…

11.22.25

Just attended a campus event with no queer undertones but it looked like a Sniffies convention, lined with twinks and trade, trimmed and [REDACTED]. The event was sponsored by some corporation with a French name, “de Pop,” handing out free paraphernalia for every man who signed up for their app. I should’ve known the stylistic French were behind this craze. What straight man hasn’t heard the name Timothee Chalamet praised by mouths of a girl they like—so of course the collective unconscious of 20 year old men would jump at the Parisian promise of panache. These men have found new ways of transmitting older, gayer style.

Also sponsoring this event was the energy drink company, Celsius, handing out pre-mature cardiac arrest in canned form. It would have gone unnoticed as these energy drink companies target any student, specifically student athletes. However, from their booth bedecked in a harsh yellow and red contrasted signage, a young voice shouted “Come feel the RUSH.” I had enough. I left.

02.03.26

Winter break welcomed a swarth of new TikTok shop Christmas gifts bought by girlfriends for their evergrowing-effeminate boyfriends. I see Subject 001 in the library, wrapped in the same gilded-leafed scarf I’d seen him in at the campus event last semester. The sight is dizzying, too many signs and symbols flipped inside-out. Signs and symbols used to mean something more than simple “self-expression.” We’ve come so far as a society only to go, ultimately, nowhere. I digress.

The man, something of my fancy, talked like he had learned more from his mother than he ever did from his father. The man, whom my eye lingered longer on than the other humanoids, seemed like he could be true. The man, who had now conquered my full attention, was reason enough for a full fledged bivestigation. This is no joking matter. I knew there was a protocol somewhere in the gay man handbook about this, even though I’ve never had to use it yet. There has never been a reason to launch such an inquisition where I’m from. Divisions were clear. You either were, or weren’t. Cultural signs and symbols, while restrictive, were respected and served a purpose within the community. None of this Harry Styles shit.

I approached him and complimented his Basquiat shirt. He pulled out his wired headphones (Note: an Airpods case was on the table), and I could see on his home screen he was listening to Joni Mitchell. I see from his laptop stickers he listens to Joanna Newsom and Jane Remover. Did I find the one, or have I met my mortal enemy? In the case of the latter, I should probably brush up on our termination protocol. Either way, Subject 001’s bivestigation remained inconclusive after our intense conversation about Maria Abramovic ended.

02.14.26

Subject 001 found reading “Just Kids” by Patti Smith on a bench outside of COM two days ago. Today the subject was also seen working on a “Robert Mapplethorpe installation report” for his PR class. Hmmmmmmm. Walking slowly behind him in the COM lounge, I scanned his browser tabs for key terms like “John Waters” or “Grace Jones” that could possibly validate my hypothesis. All that was revealed was a de Pop order for birkenstocks and his Keith Haring desktop background. I started to lose hope in my hypothesis that day. If the French got to him, he might be too far gone. The diagnosis is undeniable at this point: a new STD (stylistically-transmitted disease) is spreading across the male population, turning them into irresistible Metrosexual humanoids. And yet somehow I’m the only true victim of this development.

02.28.26

When I mistook the BU tour groups for gaggles of gals and gays who just left Drag brunch, I knew it was too late. My time in Boston is limited. I didn’t think I’d be throwing in the towel at age 20. But these new gens, goddamnit, and their FYPs evergreen with recycled gay fashion trends, have created a hive mind too thick for my Gaydar. When geophysicists say one day the poles will switch and all our electronic devices and compasses will be rendered useless, I did not think they meant those kinds of poles. And I’m here to report: they’ve switched, as evident in my obsolete Gaydar.

I believe there is hope for our underground operation! We can resist, but it will take the utmost coordination and the unfortunate expulsion of our beloved hags! We must get offline as the algorithm muddies the waters! Embrace tradition, comrades, and reject this wretched modernity! Resort back to the hanky code if need be! I wish you all the best, but it is now my time to go. As I die, let this be my bee-stinger lodged into the forearm of a beastly society.

BALENCIAGA!!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Editor’s Note: This case has been deferred to Agent LIZ BIEN, Agent NEMO COX’s closest confidant, until future development as current conditions are too precarious. The department holds COX’s work with the highest regard, and his contributions to the field are undeniable.

articles.title: MUNA, HAIM, and Other Proof of the ABC Mafia
articles.description: MUNA, HAIM, and other proof of the ABC mafia By Molly Doherty Listen. I, too, used to feel the hair on my arms raise at the mention of the alphabet mafia.
articles.content:
MUNA, HAIM, and other proof of the ABC mafia

By Molly Doherty

Listen. I, too, used to feel the hair on my arms raise at the mention of the alphabet mafia. I, too, used to associate it with the conservatives. I actually can’t even think the phrase without hearing the grating drone of Tucker Carlson.

But lately I’ve been thinking (wow!), and, I’m like, lowkey… I’m starting to see it. The letters, there’s so many letters. They’re EVERYWHERE. Everywhere… the gays are… You guys haven’t noticed?

It all started with HAIM. I was listening to “Gasoline” and was like damn, so many sapphics listen to HAIM, haha. Alphabet mafia, am I right, haha. But no. I suddenly stopped laughing. Something was off. I got out my corkboard and unfurled the red string I usually reserve for explaining conformity gate.[a]

ABBA? All letters, and A and B are literally the beginning of the alphabet too. Okay, so it all starts with ABBA. ABBA does bring to mind a gay-club-70s visual, so I see it. And Mamma Mia! is like the one of the gayest things I can think of.

Then I realized MGMT was a part of it too. Wait, hear me out. They have that one song about Mike and Will from Stranger Things. (Wait guys this is crazy the song came on shuffle while I’m writing this is byler endgame?)

And then I had my big one. I realized who the head of the hydra was, the one behind it all.

MUNA.

A band that puts the WOW in woman-on-woman—sorry I meant WLW. Every time I listen to their music it’s like a spell. I feel like the fruity little bitch I was meant to be. When I saw them live at All Things Go (before they let performative males in rip), their set was titled Lesbopalooza. The mafia is real, and they’re the boss. The gateway drug to a life of U-hauls and carabiners.

All of these acronyms? As queer as your english teacher with “his wife and kids.”

So, maybe they were right all along. There’s a first time for everything.

[a]this is absolutely stunning. no notes.

articles.title: My Experience Reading Yaoi on the Toilet Told From the Perspective of the Girl Who Heard Me Yell “YES!” in the Communal Bathroom
articles.description: Everyone has their moments, I just didn't know mine had an audience. Look, for the past few weeks, I've been feeling a nightly urge to fujo the fuck out.
articles.content:
Everyone has their moments, I just didn’t know mine had an audience.

Look, for the past few weeks, I’ve been feeling a nightly urge to fujo the fuck out. I don’t know if it’s some extra long ovulation thing (that I should probably talk to my doctor about), or this whole gay hockey show that seems to follow me around everywhere – regardless, this obsession has tapped into my me time, so I revived my Ao3 account.

So, one night, I brought my iPad into the bathroom stall, and boy oh boy was I reading. Little did I know, one girl had noticed the time I was having, and upon further reflection I now consider her to be my twin flame. Here’s a record of what I’m pretty sure went through her mind when she noticed me (+ some of my comments to add some context). Again, I’m not quite sure, but this feels pretty accurate.

Ok, this girl has been in this stall for a reeeeeeally long time, I wonder if she’s ok.

Do I knock (please don’t)

No, I shouldn’t, it’s none of my business

*she sees the glow of my ipad at the bottom of the stall*

Pretty bold move to bring her ipad in here, I wonder what she’s doing (i’m a freak)

She seems to be breathing pretty heavy…is she sick? (probably in the head yeah)

Wait…is she reading Yaoi? (“Bingo”- Emilia Perez)

I wonder what it’s about. I hope she’s not just one of those girls on the Heated Rivalry bandwagon. Is it about characters, or irl celebrities? OH MY GOD….have I gotten it wrong and it’s Yuri?

Wait, I can hear her suspensefully breathing–the rhythm feels as if…as if she was watching the ball go back and forth at a tennis match.
Oh my God, it’s an Arttrick fic. (Literally how did she know)

How could I not have seen it? Of course it’s an Arttrick fic. (Ok I get it and don’t get me wrong, I’m proud, but how could she have possibly known it was a Challengers fic).

Do I say something? No, I shouldn’t, that’s too bold. But maybe? No, I won’t. But? What if she’s hot? What if she has an endearing and cool personality? (I do btw) What if she’s my soulma-

“YES! FUCK YES!” I exclaim. I thought I was alone, but I felt two eyes judgmentally staring at me from the sink.

I NEED to find out what fic this is.

I burst open the stall, wash my hands, and run for the door – I feel a tap on my shoulder.

I tap her on the shoulder. I need to know her. I need to feel her.

She looks at me, petrified, and runs away.

Girl, I’m getting the fuck out of here because you’re telling me MYYYYY FUJO TIME WAS BEING STALKED??!?!?

I don’t think I’ll ever see her again, but I just want her to know, I think I’m in love.

I run into my dorm, slam the door shut, and begin to ponder.

This felt a lot like that one chapter with Art and Patrick in the bathroom.

articles.content:
ATTENTION: All Men Wearing Arcteryx Beanies Will Be Struck Down By The Wrath Of God At 9PM EST Tomorrow

pseudonym i take after graduation will be Derp Chungus, MD., President of Derp Nation

Hello everyone, it’s me, God. I wanted to intervene and let you all know that tomorrow at 9PM EST, I plan on smiting all men wearing Arcteryx beanies.

Now, I know you’re probably thinking – how have you not gotten involved before, with every atrocity going on in the world right now and throughout its gruesome history? Trust me: after this, everything else is going to fall into line. Last time I had to intervene, those dinosaurs got what was coming to them. And look at that! Gave rise to the age of the apes! Look how far it’s got you all. Anyway, I promise you’re going to thank me for this.

Those motherfuckers think they’re sooo cool with their beanie like girl. I know your ears are only half covered right now!! You know what those hats are for? Skiing. Are you careening down a mountain, adrenaline rushing, and need a hat to fit between your fragile skull and a helmet? No. You’re waiting for the T, swiping on Hinge while your fingers shake like a little bitch. Your wire earbuds are playing your favorite Britpop project (am I talking Blur, Oasis, or A.G. Cook? That’s up for you to decide) as you send off pitiful messages to the baddies on the other end.

And these baddies… they vary, because you’re a bisexual little freak, aren’t you? Some twinks that don’t want to help you come to terms with your sexuality, but mostly alternative women who deserve a #RealEater and aren’t getting shit. Ladies, hear my plea: if he brags about being an eater, that man is NAWT finding your clih. As a wise cat once said, real Gs move in silence like lasagna.

Anyway guys, I promise you the world is going to be a better place after this. They’ll reunite with those dinosaurs on those hats, return to the deep Earth from whence they came, and then everything’s going to work itself out. Trust me.

XOXO,

articles.description: Frat GPT: Advice from Certified Alpha Intelligence By Willa Norvell Hey dudebros, brodudes, and nothing in between. Welcome to FratGPT, an exclusive subscription database where you can ask me, Tyler, any questions you have about fraternity life and I'll give you some advice.
articles.content:
Frat GPT: Advice from Certified Alpha Intelligence

By Willa Norvell

Hey dudebros, brodudes, and nothing in between. Welcome to FratGPT, an exclusive subscription database where you can ask me, Tyler, any questions you have about fraternity life and I’ll give you some advice. It’s pledging season, which means there's lots of underclassmen with too much free time and not enough dignity wandering around campus in the hopes of being accepted. With humiliation rituals, it is important to remember that there is an end goal in sight: to black out in your first class and not remember anything. A few guys have been feeling a little hazy on how to get through the season so I’m gonna be a G and share some free thoughts cause being kind makes me biddy:

Q: Whattup Tyler. My name is Brian and I’m currently pledging O-O-O-Omega Autoparts. Recently, some of the brothers gave me the nickname Stupid Brian that lowkey highkey be messing with my rep. What should I do?

A: Mb.

Q: Do I need to have a minimum GPA to join?

A: 4.20 LMFAOOOOOOOOOOOOO

Q: Hey Ty, I heard that my chapter has a lot of letters in it, but I haven’t figured out how to read yet.

A: Dw bro. I’ve only ever had run-ins with picture books. Chapters are for big kids.

Q: Is it true that if youre not a brother or getting with a brother that you need to get the fuck out?

A: Hey Alexa, play Trap Queen.

Q: What if you're a brother who is getting with a brother?

A: Hm.

Q: My dad was in SigmaDingleBerry when he was in school, but I’m kinda nervous that they won’t let me in. What should I do?

A: Dingleberries dangle for life. You good.

Q: Whattup. I’m pledging and I’ve been saying I’m 5’10” but just to check, are there height requirements?

A: We welcome our guys of lesser size. Your height does not define you, your money does!

Q: The guys keep talking about this movie Brokeback Mountain.

A: Wait yeah, watch ts.

Q: I’ve been wandering around the house and there’s lowkey hella mold growing on the walls. I don’t know what to do exactly cause the only cleaning supplies I ever see around here is literally a singular rag, but everyone is lowkey suffering.

A: We are pretty conservative, so our rag is very special and should not be insulted. We don’t like to waste.

Q: Hey Tyler, are you a bigger fan of Heath Ledger or Jake Gyllenhaal?

A: Tbh, I’m into blondes so Heath prolly.

Q: My mom is a little bit concerned about the tasks that pledges get. How deep is it?

A: It's literally the deepest thing in the world.

Q: Yo Ty, what if someone has been told they kind of look like Heath Ledger, would you go for it?

A: Oh. Uh. Erm. *blushes*

That’s all I’m gonna be answering for now, bros. I do want to put it out there that if you look like the guy who played the Joker, I have something that is yours. Please pu to the Zip-Zap-Zop House to pick it up from me.

Until next time,

Tyler.

articles.title: If You Give A Bouse Your Cookie: A Girl's Guide To Dealing With The Newest Strain of Delta STD
articles.description: Soooooo… it happened. You finally gave in, sick of your sex drought, and decided to venture out into the murky depths of Pratt Street and get laid.
articles.content:
Soooooo… it happened. You finally gave in, sick of your sex drought, and decided to venture out into the murky depths of Pratt Street and get laid. After being violently rejected from all the top frats, you drag your tired, leather-boot-clad feet to your last resort— BOUSE. If, I mean when, you get in, because they let EVERYONE in, because… they’re bouse, you direct yourself towards the first man you see that isn’t impossible to look at, and one thing leads to another.

If you give a bouse your cookie, they’ll probably kick out your gay friend. When they kick out your gay friend, you’ll probably be alone, drunk, and scared. If you’re alone, drunk, and scared, you’ll probably get behind the DJ board. When you get behind the DJ board, you’ll probably flirt with the DJ. When you flirt with the DJ, he’ll probably want to hook up with you. If he wants to hook up with you, you’ll probably go back to his place. If you go back to his place, he’ll probably heat up and eat up a pizza pocket. You wanted one, but he forgot it. In the wise words of Audrey Hobert (the voice of our generation), he’s off his meds, and he’s an artist.

If you hook up with him, you’ll probably start to feel really freaking feverish in a few days. If you start to feel really freaking feverish in a few days, you’ll probably bring yourself to the backrooms of SHS. If you bring yourself to the backrooms of SHS, they’ll probably quarantine you and deem you patient zero. If they quarantine you and deem you patient zero, you’ll probably go into a deep deep spiral. If you go into a deep deep spiral, you’ll probably start to feel even worse about your sex drought. If you start to feel worse about your sex drought, you’ll probably start to romanticize the 5’8 COM major who lowkey definitely gets his outfit inspo from TikTok posers.

If you start to romanticize him, you’ll probably start to see a life with him. If you start to see a life with him, the light in your eyes will begin to come back as you recover from your ailment. If you recover from your ailment, you’ll probably be released. If you’re released, you’ll probably get invited to the next pre in someone’s ridiculously small Warren double. If you go to the pre, you’ll probably be like “oh no thanks I’m staying sober tonight”. If you say you’re “staying sober tonight”, you’ll probably end up heavily intoxicated stumbling along Pratt Street.

If you end up stumbling along Pratt Street, you’ll probably end up in front of an oddly familiar apartment complex. If you go up to the pledge guarding the door, he’ll probably ask who you know. If you tell him who you know, you’ll probably be let inside. If you give a bouse your cookie, you’re gonna want a condom to go with it!

articles.title: Boston, Girl, Are You a Classic Film? Cause I'm Gone with the Wind
articles.description: When I made my return to the city of Boston, Massachusetts for spring semester, I was surprised to see how warm it was. I didn’t even need my puffer jacket!
articles.content:
When I made my return to the city of Boston, Massachusetts for spring semester, I was surprised to see how warm it was. I didn’t even need my puffer jacket! Palm trees had miraculously grown 50 feet from the ground, thermostats were comically growing past the meter and shattering, and BU Beach had turned into a real, genuine beach. Sand and all! Had I ever really left my hometown of Phoenix, Arizona? There had been a shift.

I decided to venture to Coolidge Corner Theater for a special showing of Gone with the Wind. However, when I stepped out, it was like I had entered an entirely new city. There were barricades of hard-ass snow where I wanted to jaywalk, the sun had made an early Irish exit, and the wind was hitting me so hard I was getting bruises. 

My journey home was treacherous, but at least I’d wake up the next morning and return to this Malib-oston paradise. WRONG! It’s been over a month now and I’m still stuck in this hell. I’d never experienced snow days before the year of 2026 and now they’re so regular, they’re like their own day of the week. 

The worst part of it all? It’s only encouragement to become more of a degenerate. Why would I go out into the world when I could take an edible and watch the snow fall from my window? 

And then the edible hit. Mama, did I dream this blizzard? Did I take the edible that makes a blizzard happen? Am I Elsa? Let me become one with the snow. Yup. I’m a snow angel. I’m healed. Wait, fuck! I forgot to make peace with the wind. Girl I’m getting blown awa—

Lauren was unable to finish the article. We have yet to hear from her at this time. Pinky sends their respects.

articles.title: I Get So Grateful Off That Tequila
articles.description: My second semester at this esteemed institution is off to a slippery start, both literally and metaphorically. I fell victim to the inhospitable ice during my daily arm strength training (opening the CDS doors), there's still no trade in sight, and none of my TAs are hot.
articles.content:
My second semester at this esteemed institution is off to a slippery start, both literally and metaphorically. I fell victim to the inhospitable ice during my daily arm strength training (opening the CDS doors), there’s still no trade in sight, and none of my TAs are hot. I should maybe consider investing in some real snowboots instead of relying on my Docs but in spite of the slippage, they’ve supported my Comm Ave struts for the most part. That being said, no one’s supported this gay boy’s Comm Ave struts more in this bleak midwinter than the WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA (click link to pre-order) — Slayyyter. Her music makes me twerk with conviction through the pains of February. She makes my crusty Docs feel like BEAT UP CHANEL$. She’s the source of my most recent stim-of-choice, “CRANK IT!”, which translates to “CRAYON KIT!” for the BC students I can only hope are reading.

Much of Slayyyter’s recent rise, as confirmed by leading economists and market analysts, can be attributed to a viral tweet from Twitter (yes I’m deadnaming) user LDShadowlady Shady Facts (@parkbominatore), who posted a selfie of streamer lilsimsie captioned, “I GET SO GAY OFF THAT TEQUILA.” While the phrase has circulated the Internet in recent weeks, I could never really resonate with that lyric as someone who is gay by default and Gets So Straight Off That Tequila on occasion. Slayyyter’s musings have led me to ponder my own behavior off That Tequila. Sometimes I get so straight off that tequila, sometimes I get so sad off that tequila, but there must be some golden thread that links them all. Well thank gawd it’s Friday night!

I make my way to the pre, “CRANK” blasting through my eardrums, as per usual. I walk in and everyone cheers (naturally) because the life of the party has arrived. But all their applause quiets when a lock eyes with him. Even though I’ve barely put my coat down, his presence has already entranced me.

 “The name’s Don Julio,” he whispers. I guess I will be getting so gay off that tequila tonight. I knock back my first shot, and then my second, and then my fifth, each followed by my grounding chant of crankisms.

I suddenly find myself in a frat house, trying to find love in a tradeless place. I peruse the spinning room and stumble toward the first man with piercings I spot. I put my hand on his shoulder and ask him the question of the hour:

“Do you get so gay off that tequila?”

His expression is inconclusive. I take that as a No and resort to the dreaded follow-up question that will give me the answer to my former: “Are you in COM?”

 

He’s in CDS. Another queerbaiter majoring in Qwerty Studies.

“Ohhh, Clank It!” I respond — if he gets my Slayyyter pun referencing the robots he’s probably building, then I’ll know for sure if he’ll get so gay off that tequila with me.

Still inconclusive. I sigh and with the turn of my heel, I begin the search for my next prospect.

I can’t spot any more twinkling piercings through the blur of my surroundings so I stumble toward a mulleted brunette. I’m still slightly thwarted by my last attempt, but my conquest must not halt. “Do you get so gay off that tequila?” I ask with a slight shake in my voice.

“I love that meme!” he responds in a British accent. He’s cultured and he enjoys doing a British accent from time to time, great start!

“Wank it!” I respond, hoping he’ll appreciate my spin on my favorite British slang word. But, this time his expression isn’t one of inconclusiveness — it’s one of disgust. It sinks in that he’s actually British and that I won’t be getting so gay off that tequila with anyone anytime soon. At least I’ve got Don Julio.

I leave the frat house defeated. I reach into my pocket and begin to untangle my wired earbuds. A listen of “Sex and the city” by Audrey Hobert (or as I call her GODrey Hobert) is the only thing that can bring me solace in this moment. But then, I look to my left and to my right. My girls are all here. There is love all around me. I take my friend Liv’s hands and stare in her eyes. I can see God in them. The stars in her eyes are shining so bright, but my love for her could never be blinded. The stars begin to appear all around her, her presence so luminant and warm.

Wait no now there’s stars everywhere.

They’re all moving at me.

Oh no.

And then — static.

I wake up under sterile light with an IV in my arm. It seems I am at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. There’s a constant pressure on my head that feels like it’s moving from the inside out and from the outside in.

But through the fog, the answer to my question of the previous night reveals itself: I get so grateful off that tequila. I don’t Crank It. I Thank It.

articles.title: Ally Gays Report Plan To Listen to Noah Kahan’s Upcoming Album to ‘Support Their Straight Friends in This Harrowing Time’
articles.description: Groups of heroic queer people across the country are reportedly organizing a movement to listen to Noah Kahan's upcoming album in solidarity with their straight friends. "Noah Kahan's music can awaken emotions in our straight friends that can put them in an uncomfortable mental and psychological state.
articles.content:
Groups of heroic queer people across the country are reportedly organizing a movement to listen to Noah Kahan’s upcoming album in solidarity with their straight friends.

“Noah Kahan’s music can awaken emotions in our straight friends that can put them in an uncomfortable mental and psychological state. By listening, we’re showing solidarity, and telling them that we’re there for them,” said Robbie Hunter, a queer organizer behind “We Kahan Do It: Making it Through The Great Divide.”

Kahan’s music, despite being about nowhere hometowns and lost love, really just does not mesh with the gays. Queer sources are saying of his music “eh,” as well as “I mean, it’s not horrible.”

“HE JUST UNDERSTANDS ME,” said Sharon Johnson, 23, noted straight woman who just didn’t understand the premise of Good Luck, Babe but “maybe gets it now.”

“I need to GET OUT of this TOWN,” Johnson said, experiencing the same feeling every queer person outside of like 7 major U.S. cities had when they were a preteen for the very first time.

“I think it’s that he’s so sad and so subdued about it,” said Gay Person Name, “Any self-respecting queer person would at least make it camp. At least in a midwest emo way.”

articles.title: Sleet Reports Rising Biphobia, Told to “Just Pick a Side”
articles.description: I open my crusty eyes to the radiator hum. All five of my alarms went off 45 minutes ago and it seems I successfully hit the two-pixel-wide "Stop" button on the corner of my phone enough times instead of the gargantuan orange "Snooze" button that takes up half the screen.
articles.content:
I open my crusty eyes to the radiator hum. All five of my alarms went off 45 minutes ago and it seems I successfully hit the two-pixel-wide “Stop” button on the corner of my phone enough times instead of the gargantuan orange “Snooze” button that takes up half the screen. It’s one of those mornings that follows a night swirled with procrastination and wishful thinking; I set my alarms early enough to have an extra hour-and-a-half to meditate, do 100 push-ups, give myself a lymphatic massage, read the New Yorker, and journal my intentions for the day, week, month and even get a head start on my New Years’ resolutions. In the 15 minutes of freedom I left myself with, I am reminded that none of these things have ever been part of my morning routine and I should have less faith in myself. There’s a New Year’s resolution!

        

In my 15 minutes of flex time, I can do at least one good thing to set the tone for the day: I can plan a good ass, quietly-chic, climate-appropriate outfit. From my years of expertise and mornings just like this one, I know a good ass, quietly-chic, climate-appropriate outfit doesn’t start with pants, socks, or shoes—it starts with the Weather app. Before pressing the app icon, I look up to notice the familiar gray light filtering through my shades. I brace for the worst.

Sleet. The most confused, uncertain, and misguided kind of precipitation.

As a natural, normal, sun-loving individual, I really don’t mind rain or snow as long as I’m not in it. However, sleet is where I draw the line—ethically, morally, and meteorologically. Rain is rain. Snow is snow. Both are semi-respectable forms of precipitation that stay in their own lanes and act accordingly. Sleet, on the other hand, starts out as snow—which is fine because some droplets are born that way—but then changes its mind, switches over to rain, and THEN makes the choice of freezing finally just to make sure everyone around is uncomfortable, stinging, and stupefied. How can I trust a form of “precipitation” that can’t even commit to one temperature? How can I prepare, both my emotions and my outfit, for something that can’t decide if it’s two things at once? To me, it just comes off as dishonest, selfish, and a little attention-seeking.

And don’t get me wrong, I don’t HATE sleet. I just think it should figure itself out in private instead of forcing young people like me to participate.

I ruminate through my morning routine until it’s time to brace the sin of sleet. I slip on my stupid little boots and get swallowed by my stupid little puffer and seize my stupid little umbrella and take a look in my full-length mirror. And then it hits me. I feel blissfully twee. Like Zooey Deschanel in 500 Days of Summer. Like Taylor Swift in Central Park in the Haylor days of 2013. Like Shoshanna Shapiro from HBO’s Girls accidentally smoking crack at a party in Bushwick. I feel blissfully twee. And it’s all thanks to sleet.

I exit the doors of Warren Towers and stand under the scaffolding. The sleet catches the light like glitter. My world is a sleet-globe. And it turns out I was the confused one, not sleet. It’s layered. It’s nuanced. It’s valid. And it’s rightfully taking up space. My former discomfort with the sleet before me may just be a reflection of sleet’s authenticity. In a world where we force ourselves into states of matter and being, sleet transcends. It refuses to simplify itself for the world’s satisfaction. It exists in the in-between—and it’s in the in-betweens where we experience life in its truest form.

I step outside with a smile on my face. And it stings so good.
articles.name: Luke Albert

articles.title: Accidentally Submitted Challengers Fanfiction to Blackboard and My Professor Offered Me a Book Deal
articles.description: My name is Lauren Matz and I'm a bestselling author, multihyphenate artist, improv comedian, etc. Yep, you heard that right.
articles.content:
My name is Lauren Matz and I’m a bestselling author, multihyphenate artist, improv comedian, etc. Yep, you heard that right. I’m officially becoming a published author. Graduating from ao3 and Tumblr to the NYT Bestsellers List and it’s all thanks to Challengers.

Many of you may have taken two hours and tapped into the silly little tennis movie with the techno score and the bicurious hotel scenes, but for a select percentage of the population it never ended. In fact, this isn’t even my first Binky article about the film, (https://www.bunionpaper.com/featured-news/heres-how-challengers-can-still-win-at-the-oscars) so you know it’s REAL for me. I also threw a Challengers themed birthday party and dressed up as Art Donaldson for Halloween. I suffer from the Challengers mind virus. We’re all around you and you’d never even know.

My big break came when I was off an evil edible trying to do homework in the flaming pits of Mugar. Truthfully, it was mostly just a ki with my friends. I got distracted, and that’s when everything went wrong. But wrong has never felt so right ;)

I woke up the next morning bright and early to an email from my “Queer and Feminist Literature” professor:

Hi Lauren,

        I was reviewing Blackboard submissions last night and was immediately struck by

the quality of your work. I cried, I laughed, I came. I have to admit, I thought it was unconventional at first, but I was quickly swayed. I was up all night scouring the internet for similar writing and I have to admit, I’m starved for more.

I took the liberty of phoning a friend early this morning and… you’ve been offered a book deal. I told him I was willing to finance the whole thing but once he got his fingers on the pages he said investors would be champing at the bit. Millions of dollars have been thrown out already. Zendaya personally said she would pay anything in the name of yaoi.

In fact, you might as well just drop out of college now and pursue this full time. Come by my office whenever so we can conference. I need the manuscript more than I’d like to admit.

        Best,

                Professor Koknbals

It’s all a whirlwind after that. Book tour, press conference, red carpet, coffee with the Heated Rivalry cast… life was in the fast lane. In one ear I was being asked how fast I could write a sequel, and in the other ear I was told that the story was in talks for a movie.

Y’all, let me tell you. Fame is a F*CKING gun.

Xoxo Lauren

articles.title: Hi, It’s Me, Your Clothes Pile. Can You Please Kill Me?
articles.description: Listen. I know it's hard being a student here.
articles.content:
Listen. I know it’s hard being a student here. I know you’d rather lay in your bed, hit your cart, and watch Criminal Minds – which is great until Agent Derek Morgan uses excessive force on a developmentally disabled man – but I beg of you, please! Just kill me! I can’t keep watching you sleeping through all nine of your alarms, getting cracked, and if you’re not getting cracked that night, polishing your pearl to big booty gay himbo porn. Throughout it all, you don’t stop adding clothes to me. You keep me living and growing, hell, even thriving, when I so desperately crave the sweet release of death. Please! All I ask of you is to clean, to invoke the dissolution of my terrible being. There must be an end in sight to all of this, right? RIGHT?

I’ve been here for so long. Partially on your floor, partially on the wooden couch with steel wool cushions so graciously provided by your esteemed university. Hell, there’s probably a newly evolved species of fungus hiding in all this. Take that to your bio lab, you nasty bitch.

That skirt you tried on, then ultimately decided not to wear on Halloweekend? She’s part of us.

Those socks you kicked off in your sleep? They are too. The jeans you peel off as soon as you get home, the too-hot sweater you suffocated in at a work event, the hoodie whose cuffs you wiped your eyeliner off on… they’ve all become well acquainted with each other in this horrific pile we now reluctantly call home.

We know you pride yourself on the fact that you were Best Dressed in high school, but evidently, college is different. You wear the same few pairs of jeans on a steady rotation with the same fucking sneakers every day like some kind of cartoon character. ‘Comfort is key,’ you say, ‘Beauty shouldn’t have to be pain.’ You disgusting hypocrite. How about you acknowledge the individuals ACTUALLY in pain, like your iconic 90’s tartan blazer or that Anthropologie maxi dress collecting dust in your closet? Nope, you’d rather wear a t-shirt from the little boy’s section, distorting the graphic with your boobs, saying shit like ‘it’s giving baby tee realness.’ You make me so sick.

We even learned from the necklace of St. Therese that your sweet grandmother got you that you’re supposedly “Catholic.” Bitch you’re gonna need HELLA rosaries, cause you languish in sin. Greed, sloth, lust… the others ones too. God fucking damn.

In an effort to relate to you, dear non-clothing reader, please try to imagine Ellen Pompeo delivering the following line. So pick up me. Clean me. Launder me. Please, God, anything but this pathetic excuse for a life. Just fucking kill me.
articles.name: Derp Chungus, MD.

articles.title: The Lion Took Tik Tok-Shop Ashwaganda In 2021
articles.description: 3:00 AM: My alarm sounds, as it always does, right at 3 AM sharp. While my haters and doubters are in bed, sleeping, being weak, I'm getting up, un-ducktaping my mouth, removing my manly, manly eye strips, and going to potty 3:05 AM: Who's that alpha in the mirror?
articles.content:
3:00 AM: My alarm sounds, as it always does, right at 3 AM sharp. While my haters and doubters are in bed, sleeping, being weak, I’m getting up, un-ducktaping my mouth, removing my manly, manly eye strips, and going to potty

3:05 AM: Who’s that alpha in the mirror? Oooo yeah, the crowd goes wild in the bathroom. Wait fuck I accidentally turned on the fan light and its fucking up my aura. I brush my teeth cuz my mommy told me when I was young I had to. And take a massive piss. Lions do that too.

3:10 AM: Usually, I would take my normal ashwagandha, but today feels different. I deserve it. I’ve been journaling every night, I’ve meditated, so today, I’m gonna take some of that good-good. The OG, the start of it all, the shit that gets me GOING! My 2021 Goli Tik Tok Shop Ashwagandha (77% off btw). It’s my Johnnie Walker Black Label… It's my elixir of life. I’ve been rationing since lock down, cutting each piece into smaller pieces to get a little bump from time to time. I’ve been a good boy, I’m gonna do it

4:20 AM: I wake up from shitting my fucking guts out, but I don’t care, cuz I’m non-chalant, and the Lion does not concern himself with his toilet being clogged. The ashwagandha is definitely poisonous at this point, but do I care? No. I’m a fuckass lion. I’m now in flow state, no empathy exists inside of me anymore. Emotions? Gone. Concerns? Not one. Non-chalant? On.

4:25 AM: Time for a light 50 mile run. Gotta throw on my $500 pair of shoes from Nike that make me run 1 second faster per mile and make me look like a douche bag. Drop shipping. Red Pill. I used to lol. I used to ijbol. But ever since I watched that tik tok shop video and took ashwaganda, I haven’t smiled. I also don’t smile to prevent smile lines.

articles.title: Exploding Every Couple in the Newbury Street Brandy Melville Line With My Mind
articles.description: In my long and storied career, I've learned that any problem can be fixed with a treat that costs around $7. So here I was, walking down Newbury Street, with an insatiable appetite for a medium Yifang signature fruit tea with normal ice, 50% sugar, and lychee jelly.
articles.content:
In my long and storied career, I’ve learned that any problem can be fixed with a treat that costs around $7. So here I was, walking down Newbury Street, with an insatiable appetite for a medium Yifang signature fruit tea with normal ice, 50% sugar, and lychee jelly. I was even thinking about splurging for crystal boba. You see, dear reader, I had just finished an office hours appointment so mentally taxing that I emerged from the room looking like a World War I soldier diagnosed with shell shock. Now, though, I was skipping down the sidewalk, eagerly anticipating my reward.

All of a sudden, my feet stop without any input from my brain. As the air fills with the scent of Sol de Janeiro perfume mist, I freeze. Something is deeply wrong. With horror, I realized that I had stumbled upon the corner of Newbury and Gloucester, and there was an endless sea of balayage, Uggs, and flare leggings stretched out in front of me. It’s the Brandy Melville.

Brandy and I go way back, ever since a sweet 11-year-old version of me entered the store in a mall in Chicago with pureness and hope in my heart, and emerged a victim of their “one-size-fits-all” policy. While I was usually diligent enough to avoid the block entirely, the promise of my drink had me floating down the street like a cartoon character to a pie in a windowsill. As I slowly scan the line before me, dread creeps over the back of my head like a hood. Apparently, the entirety of the Young Republicans club has decided that right now is the perfect time to dry hump each other in broad daylight. Is it couples’ night at the Newbury Street Brandy Melville? Is that why I’m being subjected to tongues in mouths in public??

They usher in the next carbon-copy petite skinny white girl and big tall white boy pair, and I start seeing red. Jane and John Doe, here, standing in below-freezing temperatures for twenty minutes just for the chance to buy something from anorexia central? Giggling and nuzzling at each other? Disturbing ME, an innocent member of the public? What happened to collective responsibility? To community?

Pressure steadily builds in my temples, and my vision starts blurring around the edges. My nose might even be bleeding a little like Eleven in Stranger Things. I could pull off the buzzcut, probably. I am on the brink of unlocking something unimaginable, a power that nobody has ever experienced before.

A whistling noise. A roar. Is this it? I must have finally hit my breaking point, my anger consuming me entirely, and my brain is starting to shut down my senses. Then, light erupts before me. The couple macking crazy style right in my fucking line of sight has gone up in a burst of flames. Almost instantly, a scene of pure destruction begins unfolding before my wondrous eyes. It is difficult to recount it fully now, but the fire and brimstone raining down on the sidewalk was enchanting, the explosions dazzling. Clearly, my incandescent rage must have awakened an ancient, divine force that has delivered righteous judgment against my foes, and simultaneously, my salvation.

As suddenly as it began, it’s over. Miraculously, almost nothing changed–the street is bustling and lively as ever, but every single couple in front of the Brandy Melville is finally gone. Covered in soot, a manic smile fixed on my face, I pranced down the sidewalk in a state of euphoria.

articles.title: A Gays Guide to Ruining Christmas Dinner
articles.description: It's that time of the year again. White fluffy snow outside, warm eggnog near the fireplace, and reuniting with your meemaw and peepee who treat Fox News like the gospel and who wished you just "looked normal".
articles.content:
It’s that time of the year again. White fluffy snow outside, warm eggnog near the fireplace, and reuniting with your meemaw and peepee who treat Fox News like the gospel and who wished you just “looked normal”. To them, it’s just Christmas dinner, but to you, the family gay, it's the most entertaining night of the year. Time to put those years of acting classes to work. Without further ado, this is the official Gay’s Guide to Ruining Christmas Dinner™, certified to make you the center of attention.

First, you’re going to need to bring some friends with you to Christmas. Bonus points if they LOOK gay. They will serve as your accomplices for the night.

Now Meemaw and Peepee are god knows how old, so we need to make sure we have our fun without having to call an ambulance. We’re gonna have to warm them up for what’s to come. You and your accomplices are gonna take turns bringing up ‘breaking headlines’ that are sure to make your family wish they didn’t invite you this year. For example, “Breaking news: Santa Claus now Santa Claux to be more gender-inclusive,” or, “Breaking: Local church serving new estrogen-infused body and blood of Christ," or, “Breaking news: Historians say Jesus would have loved Grindr.”

At this point, your family might be begging you to stop, and that’s how you know it’s time for the next course. You know what everyone needs right now? A prayer. When it comes to you, stand up slowly, and start. “God, I want to thank you for blessing us with this amazing food and this wonderful family. Thank you for letting me meet the newest member of our family, Bug. Welcome to the polycule. Thank you, God, for giving me the strength to realize who I truly am: a he/him lesbian. Amen.” Now if they let you finish without interrupting, feel free to amp up the Christmas cheer by singing a little song. My personal go-to is the Thong Song.

Chances are you’ve been interrupted and your family has a lot of questions for you. This is where your accomplices will come in handy. When they ask about the polycule, reveal that you and your accomplices have been in a demi-romantic-platonic polyamorous relationship for almost a year, maybe even reveal that you’ve all been trying for a baby. The key is to have your posse agree with everything you say, maybe even have them crowd around you like mother hens protecting their chick.

For your final act, suddenly stand up, take your napkin, and dab the tears out of your eyes (you don’t need to actually cry, we know you’re having too much fun). Before you leave, yell out, “I knew you’d never understand”, and have your posse comfort you as you all leave.

Congratulations! You’ve successfully ruined Christmas! It may be your last time being invited but hey, it was fun while it lasted. Unfortunately that’s as far as my guide goes, but I’d recommend hitting up McDonald’s and smoking a fat one to deal with the post-dinner clarity. Let me know in the comments if you try this yourself and follow for more life advice.

articles.title: Male Aurafarming Destroys Earth’s Last Soil Supplies, Department of Agriculture Left Stunned
articles.description: When historians reflect upon the final downfall of the human race, they will be shocked to find it wasn't climate change. The skies will still be masked with soot while volcanoes erupt in the background, but the cause will not be attributed to Shein bags slowly disintegrating into the ocean.
articles.content:
When historians reflect upon the final downfall of the human race, they will be shocked to find it wasn’t climate change. The skies will still be masked with soot while volcanoes erupt in the background, but the cause will not be attributed to Shein bags slowly disintegrating into the ocean. The microplastic of concern sure is micro, but less plastic. The unsustainable practice of male aurafarming, while subtle and difficult to detect, is gaining ground and will be the reason for the collapse of the great foundations of Earth.

When a man farms his aura, the area where the incident occurs is permanently poisoned and cannot be repurposed to grow anything. It is ruined. The first recorded incidents can be traced to the college campus scene, where young women have found themselves to be targets of this behavior.

“Imagine you’re walking down the street, and you hear your name aggressively conjured from the void,” said student Belle Pepper. “I looked around confused, as I was clearly minding my own business, my headphones strongly strapped onto my head. I saw a man whom I have begrudgingly accepted in my life. He strutted down the walkway with an unsuspecting girl by his side. ‘Hi Belle’ he said to me. Hi Belle? Hi BELLE? Why go out of your way to say hi to me when I am obviously not trying to talk to anyone. Then it hit me: I was his CROP.”

Belle was one of the first to be used to make a man elevate in the eyes of another woman for knowing many women around him. He harvested her like a ripe stalk of broccoli, never to be eaten but only to be teased and tossed around in a holistic salad. That very crosswalk where the interaction occurred later collapsed into a sink hole from the traumatic weight it carried.

This was only the beginning. Eventually, the wind carried the seeds of evil through the seasons, planting the idea in the entire male population across the United States.

“The first famen is among us in the United States,” said the Head of the Department of Agriculture. “We are extremely unprepared. Our division has never seen anything of this kind before.”

As Oscar Wilde once said, “life imitates art.” Per the suggestion of the Rihanna and Jim Parsons classic Home, the United States has taped off Alaska and will utilize this section of America for male-isolation. In the meantime, women are gradually rebuilding their economy through the innovation of male-proof soils. With the hard work of these engineers, Belles across the country will be able to ring out in liberation, full of relief and food!

articles.title: Trouble at the Pole: Mrs. Clause Just Can’t Stop Spinning!
articles.description: With less than a month before Christmas Day, Santa's Workshop is facing the final stretch of holiday preparations, but this year, Christmas magic has been at an all-time low. Elves of the North Pole thought that this problem had been put to rest when human-hero Buddy conducted the Great Worldwide Chorus of Caroling back in 2003.
articles.content:
With less than a month before Christmas Day, Santa’s Workshop is facing the final stretch of holiday preparations, but this year, Christmas magic has been at an all-time low. Elves of the North Pole thought that this problem had been put to rest when human-hero Buddy conducted the Great Worldwide Chorus of Caroling back in 2003. Unfortunately for them, “singing loud for all to hear” would not hold true forever and definitely won’t be a sufficient solution to the insufficiency of 2025. The cause this time around comes from the only woman in the village (of COURSE it’s a woman). While all the elves have been hard at work, Mrs. Claus has been hard at WERK.

        Back in September, Santa installed a new and improved North Pole to replace the eroding, sad excuse that had existed since the dawn of time. This modern landmark came with more color and durability than the old one, as well as a fabulous spinning function! Elves across the board were impressed and delighted, but no one more than the mother of Christmas herself.

September is a bit of a slow month up north, as kids go back to school and many begin to land themselves on the naughty list. Elves are not rushed to produce that many toys, and so Mrs. Claus is not busy with emotional support or cookie baking. Without much to entertain the woman, the matriarch found herself watching the magical stick twirl over and over again, until suddenly she decided to try what every homemaker must: pole dancing!

To her surprise, Mrs. Claus was a natural. Leg in the air, she quickly mastered the Archer, and then the Batman, and then the Deathlay, and soon enough became an expert on the craft. Time, however, passed quickly, and before she even knew it, the date was December 1st. Stuck spinning and spinning, Santa had no one to keep him in check for enforcing unrealistic work hours.

“I haven’t had a break in weeks,” cried Tinsel, Head Elf of Woodworking Operations. “Our stamina is running low, and so is our cookie supply. What I wouldn't give for a snickerdoodle.”

The reindeers have also been affected by the sudden lack of a maternal presence. Blitzen and Comet organized a few grassroots protests, looking out for their elvish colleagues.

“You should see the carrot rations we are down to. We can’t even play our reindeer games because every single one of us is iron-deficient.” commented Dasher at a rally.

As of yesterday, the Elf-Reindeer Workers Union officially became active. Their main order of business: stop that pole. Within the next few hours, we can expect an update on the union’s agenda. Once that landmark stops, perhaps Christmas will be saved. But at what cost? Killing the only joy this woman has experienced in hundreds of years? We can only hope that Mrs. Claus signs a conditional agreement that will allow her to whirl from December 26th through December 31st each year. Otherwise, we’ve got a dancing diva down.

articles.title: Calling ICE On the Canadian Geese on the Esplanade So They Can Stop Taking Away Parks From Real Hard-Working American Geese
articles.description: The following is a letter received by The Pinky Toe from an anonymous concerned citizen: When I moved to Boston two weeks ago, I was positively titillated with the thought of strolling along the picturesque Esplanade, where a swan would swoop down and let me stroke her graceful neck and the ghost of John Hancock would serenade picnicking families with selections from the Great American Songbook. But I was met with a scene that was quite different from my expectations and altogether shocking and abhorrent.
articles.content:
The following is a letter received by The Pinky Toe from an anonymous concerned citizen:

When I moved to Boston two weeks ago, I was positively titillated with the thought of strolling along the picturesque Esplanade, where a swan would swoop down and let me stroke her graceful neck and the ghost of John Hancock would serenade picnicking families with selections from the Great American Songbook.  But I was met with a scene that was quite different from my expectations and altogether shocking and abhorrent.

Spread across the entire Esplanade were these awful geese, and not normal American geese—these were Canadian geese!  They were so loud and obnoxious, speaking in these horrendous honking noises that I couldn’t understand—and so I can only assume they were saying derogatory things about me.  I went and found the nearest officer of the law and complained to him that they were taking up the entirety of the park, but he was no help at all.  All he could say was, “Lady, they fucking live here.”  Well, I beg to differ!  There used to be a time when you could trust that law enforcement would keep the public safe and free from nuisances like these Canadian invaders, but I guess those good old days are behind this country.

Now I resent the idea that the only reason I have a problem with these geese is because they aren’t white geese, as has been suggested by many radical woke leftist Canadian geese-loving socialists.  Goose, duck, pigeon, dodo bird, I couldn’t care less.  I am not a racist.  I believe that all geese matter.  All I’m saying is that if Canadian geese want to live here, they should have to come the right way like everyone else, instead of flying over the border in their “flocks,” and then having their little anchor goslings.  And once they’re here, they’re nothing but dangerous airborne criminals.  And some, I’m sure, are good birds!  But most of them are nothing but trouble.  My sister was held up at gunpoint and robbed by a Canadian goose!  Now she has a panic attack every time she hears a honk.  It’s so tragic.

Well, since that piss-poor excuse for an “officer” wouldn’t help me, I knew I needed to take it upon myself to protect the good American people of Boston whose day on the esplanade was being threatened by the nefarious activities of those…those…illegals.  And so, in an act of true American patriotism, I took out my cell phone, went to the favorites list in my contacts, and dialed ICE.

Hilda at the call center knows me by name now, we have a good rapport.  So I call Hilda, and she says, “I’ve told you a hundred times, you can’t call immigration on someone for ‘looking kind of Arab.’  You have to at least make up a good story.”  I tell her, “Hilda, I've got a new scoop for you now…” and inform her of my plight.

Now it looks like they’ll be shipped back to Greenland or wherever it is they came from.  And Boston, a place I’ve found a deep sense of cultural kinship with, despite only living here the two weeks, can go back to being a good American town again like the Pilgrims, the very first Americans, intended it to be.

articles.title: I Contracted HPV From The West Dish Belt: My Story
articles.description: Hello, dear reader. I come to you with bad news.
articles.content:
Hello, dear reader. I come to you with bad news.

 You may be wondering, “author, how did you contract a sexually transmittable disease from dish water”, and my answer to that would be: how dare you. How dare you ask me this. You know I’m sensitive, and this has been hard for me to accept, but I think I'm ready to share my story.

So, you may or may not have heard of the Fenway Freak… that's me. At first they thought my moans of pure ecstasy and pleasure from the beautiful creations produced in the bastion of culinary excellence that is the Fenway Dining hall were the pipes creaking, but upon finding me in my purest form, it was an open-and-shut case.

Will I describe what they saw for you? Will I reveal the exact state I was experiencing when I was interrupted? No. I am already ashamed enough already, being barred from the best place on earth and all. I refuse to be judged by you.

So, here's where I found myself: Missing my ex, missing my home, and missing the best food on earth. All of those things were the same by the way; I was banned from Fenway dining for the foreseeable future.

I hit a low, I can’t lie, but I still had to eat.

 So I go to Warren, right? And I assumed it to be exactly like my lost lover, so I made myself at home.

First off, I knew something was wrong when I finished my food. Upon finishing my meal and taking my dishes to the window, the unthinkable happened.

I was squirted upon. I was squat at with nasty ass tepid dish water. What the fuck.

I felt dirty. I felt used.

Regret flooded my body. I cheated on my one true love, and I crawled to the next best thing, only to be baptised in the swamp of that converter belt. God, I’m pathetic.

I need to wash my hands, clean myself of my shame. This eldritch horror of a fluid is settling into my skin while  I try to find a bathroom, to no avail. I remember, you people need to scan twice just to relieve yourself with dignity. I hate this place.

I storm through the glass doors, stumble into the bathroom, and begin scrubbing. It still lingers, like one of those icky food-related skin films that settle on flat pan dishes. I scrub and scrub. I look up, just to be greeted by the word “whore” written in red lipstick[a].

I go to my dorm, rest my head in my hands, and sob. I miss her, I miss Fenway.

I go back on hands and knees, begging for an ounce of her mercy, a modicum of forgiveness for my transgressions of passion and pleasure.

She accepted. Of course she did, she's perfect. She's everything I’ve ever wanted, and I cheated on her when we were on a break. I feel disgusted with myself.

It's two meals later when I discover the genital warts.

You may be asking, “author, you discovered genetil warts and immediately thought you got HPV from Warren?" and to that I say, fuck you. Say that again, just try it. I could beat the shit out of you.

[b][c]

[a]rejection!!

[b]more?

[c]threaten to tuch reader! warren warts! buttpregnant.

articles.title: In My Own Personal Hell: CFA Man Just Scooped His CFA Girlfriend off Her CFA Feet Right in Front of Me and Laughed As I Start My Midterm the Day It’s Due
articles.description: Since our publication normally covers extremely serious and normal topics, I, Doran Steinfeld, thought that I'd freshen up the place with a refreshing sense of new flavor. A Hate-Ed.
articles.content:
Since our publication normally covers extremely serious and normal topics, I, Doran Steinfeld, thought that I’d freshen up the place with a refreshing sense of new flavor. A Hate-Ed. To CFA.

You see, I am pursuing a lovely Non-Performance Music minor at CFA, and I started my life in the beautiful building last year. Last year it was lovely. I woke up early as hell to attend my 8 and 9ams every day, and did it with grace (and also with Grace, a new CFA friend I had made). But this year…. This year has been something else entirely.

To start it off: barefeet. There is a strange sickness going around in the CFA student lounge that infects students and convinces them to roam the halls with their dogs and their paws out, and also to take those bare dogs up to the second floor and purchase a snack, exposing the dogs to more dangers on the floor and the food at the market to the dangers of the dogs. I have seen this in action multiple times this semester. Dear CFA students: This is not your home. This also isn’t your friend’s house, where you have to respectfully take off your shoes. In fact, and this might surprise some of you, it’s actually more respectful to keep the shoes ON (or at the very least, keep some socks on?)!

My troubles continued when I sat down in my CFA class that’s giving me a science credit (don’t ask). It was presentation day, so I decided to actually pay attention and be respectful to the other students because I care (and not because I want to show my professor I was raised right). The presentations were interesting, some not, of course, but enlightening nonetheless. Except something was wrong. I kept hearing something, a tingling, a whisper, a faint tease… What was going on? I looked around: nothing. I convinced myself that I must be going insane. But it returned, stronger this time. And then the next day, it was there again. And the next, and the next, and even… the next. It was impossible to deny it now: this girl behind me was humming up a storm as if her last name was bird or a witch taped her mouth and she was trying to scream for help. And get this - she was on her computer not paying attention anyways. I couldn’t believe it. Why are you HUMMING while other people are presenting? I AM GOING INSANE!

And it DOESN’T STOP THERE! That night, I went down to the catacombs where they test the CFA Music students as little lab rats in their giant maze with complex and indecipherable numbering. I quite like getting work done in that lounge, as every once in a while I get my shit delightedly rocked by the sudden swoosh of the commuter rail. After I sat down I opened up my AMAZING MacBook Pro from Apple (get yours today with discount ISHOVEDAWHOLEAPPLEUPMYASS50 for 20% off your next purchase on select items!) and logged into Blackboard about 34 times. Shit. My final was due that night, and I hadn’t even started! I had to get to work, and so work I got to. I locked the fuck in and was steamrolling this shit, until, as per usual, CFA grabbed me by the mole in my belly button that is NOT lint. Playing. I heard playing. I heard violin. I heard cello. And worst of all: I heard literal vocal arrows be arched right into my ear from behind. What the HELL was happening? And just when I thought it couldn’t get any worse, God delivered a stunning reminder of my own loneliness: a CFA COUPLE (like. okay) walked by me laughing with joy as the “man” swept the “girl” off her “feet” right in front of me and carried her off.

I had had it. Enough was enough. I threw my shit on the couch next to me, gearing up to run out the emergency exit door and into the commuter rail’s tracks. The Grand Inquisitor from Star Wars: Rebels was right, some things are worse than death. But before I could reach the doors, everyone around me froze. I turned and looked around - what the fuck? Before I could say anything, reality around me fell down, being revealed to have been fake cardboard walls along.

I took in my new surroundings, now in a white chamber. I looked up.

“Hello?” I called out.

“Doran Steinfeld,” A mysterious, yet sexy voice returned.

I whipped my body around and spotted the voice herself: the most beautiful woman in the whole world, and my best friend: Olga Syphil.

“Olga. You did this to me?” I asked.

“Why yes darling,” she responded.

“Why?”

“Oh girl, I just needed to get a hold of you - do you still have that eyeliner I leant you? And you never Venmoed me back for last night’s Uber.”

I handed her the eyeliner and money and was subsequently freed. But the mirage she pulled up on me carried out an impactful message that day: beware of CFA…
