articles.title: This Is So Freudian! And Other Things I Say To Justify My Nicotine Addiction.
articles.description: I don't even like them that much! I could quit anytime!
articles.content:
I don't even like them that much! I could quit anytime! I only smoke a pack a week!

All of these phrases have been uttered by me and my fellow smokers for centuries, attempting to rationalize why we continue to put tar straight into our lungs. The answer most of the time, is nothing reasonable, mainly that I look cool and my lexapro no longer works so I have nothing to regulate my nervous system.

Sometimes the oral fixation of putting something into my mouth, the beautiful intake of 92 carcinogens and the sweet release brings me a comfort only Freud could understand. My mom was also a smoker, I wonder what he would think of that.

But I look so cool! They make my films 2.3x more profound!

Smoking on COM lawn at 2pm is aura? Right? I’m a film major, what else am I supposed to do besides be a degenerate and debate Paul Thomas Anderson new film?

Half of the connections in the film industry are made on smoke breaks, a new Deadline report says. Look, at least every cool artist has a photo where they smoke a cig, it stimulates the brain!

What else am I supposed to do with my hands? Where should I place my lips? Is this working? Those aren't things I say during sex, those are words that I say to “you should quit while you're ahead!”. Fuck you. Let them live in a non-binary world.

Overall, I think it’s okay to have a nicotine addiction if you’re cool.

articles.title: Beautiful Wonderful Fairy Angel With Pure Heart And Golden Soul Does Not Concern Themselves With Whether They Look High Right Now
articles.description: Around nine on Thursday, I awoke from my peaceful slumber and climbed out of my gleaming chrysalis after a long night of communing with trees through my dreams.
articles.content:
Beautiful Wonderful Fairy Angel With Pure Heart And Golden Soul Does Not Concern Themselves With Whether They Look High Right Now

Around nine on Thursday, I awoke from my peaceful slumber and climbed out of my gleaming chrysalis after a long night of communing with trees through my dreams. The sunlight streaming in through the windows was particularly bright on my naturally dewy, glowing face, warming my rosy cheeks.

I wouldn’t have class until later in the afternoon, so I decided to begin my morning with a fresh bowl, not of cereal, but a breakfast of champions known to many as the Wake and Bake ritual. I packed a sticky bowl of some strain called Alien Taint and cracked open my energy drink.

I checked my phone, because I’m addicted to the ragebait on my Twitter (yes, I deadname her) timeline. Huh. That’s strange, there’s a private GroupMe message from my RA. They want to see me downstairs? A surge of anxiety rushed through my petite frame. I effortlessly threw my hair into a messy bun, tucked my feet into my Ugg slippers, and finished smoking my bowl before heading out.

On the first floor, I’m greeted with… oh my god, is that… iconic boy band One Direction? No, wait, my vision focused, and it’s just the gay boys that live in the basement apartment-style dorm. I held the door for them – two say thanks, one is busy listening to Snow Strippers (totally get it), and one looked me up and down with an unreadable facial expression. I’m too autistic for all that, so I chose to disregard it and continued towards the end of the hall where my RA waited for me with an odd-looking man. He was dressed in green robes that seemed to glisten in the hazy light emanating from the boob-like ceiling lamp above us.

“Hey, so, hate to be the bearer of bad news, but your department head had to sell you to the fairy kingdom since they got all their federal research funding cut. They’re like, super sorry, but you actually signed a document agreeing to this earlier in the semester,” my RA says, forcing a smile through it all. God fucking dammit. This was just my luck! Here I was, a senior about to finish my degree, high as shit, still in my jammies, being sold to the fucking fairy kingdom.

“Oh, there’s no need to worry, my dear!” the man in green exclaimed. I fixed my face, realizing I had definitely been making one. “I promise you’ll feel just dandy once you get settled. Haven’t you always felt… a bit different? From your peers? More attuned to the voices of the voiceless, able to recognize the underlying patterns in nature that this glorious earth wants you to see. My guess is that some would probably describe you as a manic pixie dream girl?”

“I’m nonbinary, hoe.”

He waved his hands around apologetically. “Right, right. But I’m close on all the other stuff?”

“Prolly,” I shrugged.

“Hold on.” He leaned in, staring intently at my eyes. I could really see how old he was up close, and his wrinkles shone beneath the boob light. It was weird as fuck, but with the morning I’d been having, I didn’t really care. “Are you… high?” he asked.

I could feel my body start tweaking before it hit my brain. I’m gonna be in so much trouble. I tried to speak, but my cotton mouth was so bad that I got too embarrassed and started shaking my head but ended up nodding instead.

“MARVELOUS!” he exclaimed, jumping up and down and clapping excitedly. What the fuck? “You’re exactly as the prophecy foretold!”

Oh my god bruh. My terror transformed into confusion (but also quite a bit of relief).

“We have been searching for you! You are the one they have written of in the ancient tomes. We are a centuries-old people, and we have long-possessed and harnessed the powers of the plant you are so fond of.”

Whatever I smoked had to be laced or something. That’s the only possible explanation. “That’s lit and all… but like… what do you want from me?”

“We need someone who is willing to sit on this bed of moss, watch Youtube, and smoke our weed all day,”

“Wait yeah 😭I’m so down as long as y’all have Family Guy clips,” I said. We might be nearing the end times, so I might as well enjoy myself.

“How the fuck did you just say that emoji?” he asked, but I just stared at him blankly. I was occupied thinking about the plane crash analysis videos I’d get to watch fried. He shook his head. “Never mind. This is great news, and of course we do. It’s all been prepared for years, it was foretold.”

He escorted me outside to a dragonfly-drawn carriage, with Charli XCX softly emanating from the interior. Multiple bikers yelled at it to get out of the bike lane.

“I’ve had the sprites pack up your things. They were actually really impressed with your collection of ironic shirts and the books that you swear you’re going to read this semester.”

“You don’t have to keep glazing me, I’m already sold.”

“Perfect. Now, let’s go to 7/11. You could go for something, right?”

A tear of joy slid down my cheek. “Yeah. Yeah, I could.”
articles.name: Derp Chungus, MD.

articles.title: First I LOLed, Then I Serioused: Being God’s Number One Giggler in These Trying Times
articles.description: We are living in a dark age for comedy and NOBODY wants to address it. Sure, everything is awfully dire, but as far as I know, it is STILL LEGAL TO LAUGH.
articles.content:
We are living in a dark age for comedy and NOBODY wants to address it. Sure, everything is awfully dire, but as far as I know, it is STILL LEGAL TO LAUGH. For now, at least.

Besides the serious implications of taking several late-night comedians off the air, a girl has to wonder… why are they only coming for the gigglers? Surely there are some real stoic, unfunny types that like to criticize the government too. But allllll the funny people are getting knocked down like sitting ducks. Just saying, I can think of a few people who hate Trump that aren’t comedians… come for Gracie Abrams instead I MEAN– Who said that?

Anyways, even my own peers are losing their ability to laugh. The other day in my screenwriting class I pitched a comedy and was met with nothing but blank stares. I was shocked– when I showed the pitch to my fellow LOLers it was a hoot and a half! Are we living in a world where a simple COMEDY is a hard sell???

“What if you turned the opening scene into a horror?” one of my classmates asked. Another chimed in: “I think you should focus more on the disappointment your character feels towards her roommate.” Of course, I took every suggestion with grace. But would it be so absurd to just keep a comedy a comedy? Surely they will come to appreciate getting to chuckle a little bit during table reads when every other script is about someone’s dead grandma.

If you’re reading this article, you clearly have some appreciation for the magic and whimsy of laughter. So, dear reader, let me make it known that it is in fact this particular giggler’s birthday today. If you’re feeling so inclined to celebrate it, I compel you to go and spread the giggle gospel as much as you can– it is clearly a dying art. As the 1952 film Singin’ in the Rain says, make ‘em laugh! Go hoot and holler with your friends! Slip on a banana peel in the dining hall! Maybe repost a meme or two to your close friends story (or main if you dare.) You know what they say: If you can’t beat them, make jokes about them… or something along those lines. Giggler GoFundMe linked in my bio xoxo.

articles.title: The DL Trade Winds Are Coming and They Might Scoop Up My Friend Jessica
articles.description: I have this friend. We'll call her Jessica.
articles.content:
I have this friend. We’ll call her Jessica. She is so obviously gay, but she won’t admit it to me. She acts really interested whenever I mention anything about how I’m gay, as if this is a new perspective she hadn’t considered before. One time, I even heard her call a man cute (It was really quickly, in passing one time. She yelled it to him on the street. Now that I think about it, she may have said “I like your boots”).

My gay friends (I collect them by the pound) have all asked me about her, wondering which way she swings. I always tell them the same thing: that she never said anything about it, but I believed in the deep dark pits of my soul that she was gay and messing with me. I mean, it’s constant. Her hair, her voice, her clothes, her posture, it all points to one answer, right? And women flock to her like there’s no tomorrow. I watch how she behaves, and she always lightly denies them without saying anything about how she's not interested or taken. Just that she’s “not looking for any trouble tonight,” ????????? well what the hell does that mean!

All of this to say, when I heard about how the DL trade winds were coming, I was getting scared. What do you mean the supergaystorm would finally get an answer to the Jessica situation before I did? Not to mention, what if Jessica never got to live her true gay self because the DL trade winds were going to whisk her away!!!

For those confused, let's back things up a bit. Some people are familiar with the trade winds, which are winds that blow from the east to the west from 30 degrees north to 30 degrees west. The DL trade winds are similar, a collection of winds that blow around the world, scooping up all the DL gay people each year to relocate them in the hopes that they can find themselves somewhere else. If this sounds like you, it means not all hope is lost!!!! But back to Jessica.

I am afraid. Jessica if you’re reading this please don’t be afraid to be who you are and I will accept you and don’t let the DL trade winds get you because we have that group presentation Wednesday and you lowkey still owe me $15 and I really enjoy being your friend and maybe when this is all over I can buy you a frozen yogurt and we can clear this up okay???? Wear lots of layers this weekend. Eat a cheeseburger. If it starts feeling breezy out, head to the nearest GSA community center and STAY PUT. I am already on my way. Kisses and I’ll be waiting.

B

articles.content:
Sunday, September 4th – A recent report from BuzzFeed News, 4 time winner of the “Yes, We ARE a News Source” Award, reported that a whistle blower from the Try Guys corporation confirms that Eugene Lee Yang is the only member of the Try Guys who truly tried men. This casts doubt on the entire entertainment group including human-beanpole Keith Habersberg, and lactose intolerant gremlin Zach Kornfeld. This scandal shocked many people, primarily those who have never seen Mr. Lee Yang’s outfits. The response from those familiar with Try Guys reacted to the report with a unanimous “What???!!!” Most couldn’t believe Zach and Keith weren’t secretly a thing. While the report is damning, BuzzFeed has drawn speculation as new evidence suggests the whistle blower was PLANTED by BuzzFeed itself, to take down the Try Guys and become relevant again.

The story began a couple years back, when Try Guys separated from BuzzFeed news. This was shocking, and no one saw this coming, especially considering that no one had ever left BuzzFeed. The Try Guys began their successful Youtube journey, as they invented a new genre of video “white people trying asian food mukbang.” Their virality continued, as they filmed themselves doing other domestic tasks, trying on clothes and baking different foods. Allegedly, this is when BuzzFeed decided to end their rise and expose them to win back popularity. According to new LAPD affidavits, BuzzFeed news found a gay UCLA journalism major doing poppers at a rave in Long Beach and hired him on the spot. Once they had acquired their double agent, they peer-pressured him with no effort to work as an assistant for the Try Guys, at which point he would try to seduce them and expose them. According to a leak from inside BuzzFeed, they even had an article and press release ready, called “Try Guys? More like Try Gays!” 

The smear campaign was ultimately unsuccessful for many reasons. Despite many attempts, the double agent was not able to seduce Zach Kornfeld because Zach was literally allergic to everything that the intern was wearing or eating. On lunch breaks, the intern attempted to make a move, but when Zach noticed he drank coffee with milk right before. Zach is deathly allergic to dairy, and immediately ran away crying while hurting all his joints and bones, as he has a strange skeletal condition.

The intern altered course, and eyed Keith as his next victim. Keith’s microplastic-filled, fast food-built tree-trunk of a body made him very attractive to the spy. However, his whorish advances ultimately fell short, because Keith was far too tall and large, considering the fact that he does a mukbang a week. . Keith’s towering height and spanning width made him about 10x larger than the meek college intern. When the intern tried to flirt, Keith thought he was an oddly shaped chicken nugget, and tried to eat him.

Defeated and scared of being outed, the intern tried his luck with Eugene, a durable enough and not massive person. Eugene, however, was the most intimidating, boasting an extremely sharp jawline and cheekbones that reflected blinding light into the eyes of anyone looking at him. The intern-spy pulled out all the stops: he poisoned Eugene’s coffee, he sprayed pheromones all over himself, he even loudly praised Eugene's film Comfort Girls (2024) at the office. This worked, and Eugene eventually opened up to the intern. “Listen you little slut, I don’t know your name, but I can tell you’re trying to out me as gay man so BuzzFeed can be relevant again. But guess what, diva? It won't werk. Cuz I’ve been out proudly for years. Did you not see my coming out dance video??? It has like 21M views!”

Hearing there was a new subordinate in town, Ned was eager to fuck the intern. He unfortunately got confused on who to cheat on his loving wife with and had sex with another employee, at which point he was kicked off the Try Guys. So yeah, that’s why that happened.

articles.title: Belly, Conrad, Jeremiah, and Other Things I’d Name My Kid if I Hated Them
articles.description: This summer, the phenomenon that is The Summer I Turned Pretty season 3 has been taking over pop culture once again. If there's one thing our generation is gonna do, it's love a mediocre show with subpar acting and a questionable plotline because of two middling white love interests.
articles.content:
This summer, the phenomenon that is The Summer I Turned Pretty season 3 has been taking over pop culture once again. If there’s one thing our generation is gonna do, it’s love a mediocre show with subpar acting and a questionable plotline because of two middling white love interests. That being said, the worst part of it all is that the characters have terrible names, or nicknames, that I myself wouldn’t name my children unless I had a vendetta against them from their time in the womb. Before I get into the nitty-gritty of this list, I’d like to say that I’m sincerely sorry if your name appears on this list. Actually, scratch that. I’m just sincerely sorry for you.

  1. Belly
  • Now I’ll acknowledge that this is only a nickname, but out of all the options, I think we have to agree that this is the worst. With cards on the table, such as Izzy, Belle, Bella, Isa, and many others, why would we choose Belly? At that point, you might as well just call her stomach, or abdomen, or gut, or tummy. Not so flattering anymore, now is it?
  1. Conrad
  • Now this is not even a name in my humble opinion; it’s merely a smattering of consonants and vowels. My biggest fear is the day in the not-so-distant future when I meet the first little Conrad roaming around in the world. Also, Chris Briney, along with other actors, ruined the Mean Girls movie, so I harbor a deep-seated hatred for his mediocrity.
  1. Jeremiah
  • Jeremiah is the name of the kid who eats paste in the corner of the playground and manages to be unconsciously insufferable. A perfect name for the character, I will say, but that's no excuse for Jenny Han’s actions, causing me to see it everywhere.
  1. Honorable Mentions
  • Makayleigh: White people need to stop trying to be different; it makes my eyes hurt.
  • Anyone named Richard who goes by Dick: Are you gay or something?
  • Jerica: Could you not pick one?
  • Doyle: Do I even need to comment on this one?
  • McKinley: There’s only room for one McKinley in this world, and the High School from Glee took the spot
  • Lastly, any girl whose name is something followed by Rose. You’re not special, your name is Sarah.

articles.title: Clairo-voyant: The Implications of A Performative Male Summer
articles.description: Clairo-voyant: The Implications of A Performative Male Summer By Willa Norvell A few months ago, an assembly of belligerent creatures zipped up their cocoons, festered in cells, and emerged as a new and improved species (or perhaps not so improved as we thought). The performative male (Matchalo Manipulativo) is a large boy of the genus Predatora, native to underground record stores and trendy cafes.
articles.content:
Clairo-voyant: The Implications of A Performative Male Summer

By Willa Norvell

A few months ago, an assembly of belligerent creatures zipped up their cocoons, festered in cells, and emerged as a new and improved species (or perhaps not so improved as we thought).

The performative male (Matchalo Manipulativo) is a large boy of the genus Predatora, native to underground record stores and trendy cafes. It has a pseudo-edgy appearance; loafer covered feet; headphone-bound ears; and a baseball cap protecting its empty skull. It is sexually dimorphic, often adorning Trader Joe’s tote bags and massive baggy pants, although the return of affection is far and few between.

As a zealous species, groups often gather in parks to participate in contests. A performative male contest consists of a large pride of these individuals who project “feminist-ideals” to their potential partners. Groups of female spectators usually huddle together during this ritual, giggling at the sight and posting on TikTok. The performative male believes itself to be an apex and keystone predator, although reality has shown this is far from the truth.

What does this new obsession mean for society? So much time, media space, and attention has blindly been dedicated to this cause. The lasting effects of such a cataclysmic event will be felt for months, if not years following its cessation. If the federal government feels uncomfortable to call it what it is, I will.

Firstly, it is a recession indicator. From Lana to Labubu, the fiscal consequences of this trend cannot be ignored. While an increase in matcha purchases from small businesses may have aided a handful of tiny stores, the overwhelming capitalistic return on keychains, mass produced self-help books, and pop vinyls cancels out any good.

Second, the demand for optometrists will skyrocket! Because the species attempted to cater to the “female gaze”, women all over the world are personally gauging their eyes out in the hopes that they will never have to confront the sight again. Invest in your glasses early folks, they may be out of stock soon.

Last but not least, the thrift stores across America are PICKED OVER. The worst part is that I will never look as cool wearing those big pants and cropped T as the guy who does not understand “Amoeba”.

Nevertheless, this era is coming to a close, and we must be ready to fight off the effects. Time to take back tea, save Sally Rooney, and clutch those carabiners close to our chests.
articles.name: Willa Norvell

articles.title: Group Projects Make Me Feel Like a Cop: A Prison Abolitionist’s Perspective
articles.description: Group Project Rant I am a principled man. A moral man.
articles.content:
I am a principled man. A moral man. A man who stands in the face of injustice in all of its various forms. I do all the good, neighborly things, like feeding stray cats and helping old ladies across the street. I like to think I am generally a pleasant person to be around.

This is why you should take my perspective in good faith when I tell you, nay, implore you, that we need to start being normal in group projects. Look. I understand that my needing a good GPA to apply to grad school is not the base case. I also understand that only receiving validation in its academic forms when I was younger has permanently soul-bonded me to being a tryhard forever. I am not happy about this. But if I keep incurring the costs of being the cop in the group project, I will blame YOU in my suicide note after the accumulated psychic damage drives me over the edge.

We are all adults here. So I don’t understand why I have to send three emails that say, “just following up on this …” in order for anyone to look at the Google Doc. I look soooo pathetic quintuple-texting the project group chat begging people to work on the slideshow. I haven’t done that since I drunkenly messaged my high school ex-situationship in a frat basement in my freshman year of college. Why are you making me relive that for an intro-level lecture class?

I believe strongly that the only way to achieve a just and moral world is to entirely dismantle the justice system in its current forms, so you can imagine the extreme cognitive dissonance I’m experiencing cuts me to my core. I’ve been reduced to an arm of the oppressive state (200-level class), upholding the status quo through rigid enforcement (scheduling meetings and splitting up work), and doling out vicious, disproportionate punitive measures for any disruptions to the system (writing negative group member evals sometimes). The authoritarian role I adopt goes against everything that I stand for, making me an abhorrent, sickening hypocrite. I’ve AC’d my last AB. I’ve 13’d my last 12. And finally, I’ve become the bastard. What a cruel twist of fate.

It’s also, like, I just know I’m being saddled with this responsibility because I’m Asian. And also a woman (well like not really at all but it’s complicated). I’m an Asian woman (kind of) and you want me to be your secretary and your calculator and your calendar and your reminders app and your science-fiction android and you hate me so bad!!! Why else would you make me police the progress and quality of our project? The spirit of a group project lies in collective responsibility and community collaboration, and I am now the representative of state oppression in the form of a Chinese they-cop. What the hell? The karmic debt I’m incurring will never leave me and I’m going to hell now. And it’s all your fault.
articles.name: Group Projects Make Me Feel Like a Cop: A Prison Abolitionist’s Perspective

articles.title: White Women Sure Love Showing You Their Sensible Shoes
articles.description: This just in: The second most comfortable group of people in society has found a way to make themselves even more comfortable. Gone are the days of sky-high stiletto pumps that gave Lindsay from Omaha her chance to feel like Ke$ha for just one wild night.
articles.content:
This just in: The second most comfortable group of people in society has found a way to make themselves even more comfortable.

Gone are the days of sky-high stiletto pumps that gave Lindsay from Omaha her chance to feel like Ke$ha for just one wild night.  Gone are the Christian girl autumn booties that, as much as we make fun, are objectively a cozy comfy pumpkin-spiced slay.  Out of the shadows of these eras rises a new shoe, a shoe from humble beginnings that proved to be up to the task of meeting all the demands the life of a white woman could throw at it.  It did not tremble at the foot traffic of the organic farmer’s market.  It braved five mile hikes, two hours worth of post-pilates sweat, and a yoga retreat all in one weekend.  A white woman could go to the bathroom and find that her shoe had ordered her a caesar salad and a side of fries by the time she’d gotten back.  Who was this new hero?  The sensible shoe.

Tevas, Chacos, Birkenstalks, and Doc Martens (but in a purely heterosexual fashion) have begun sprouting up on white women’s feet in every corner of the market.  Sporty white women, preppy white women, those white women obsessed with nature who don’t shower, straight, gay, bisexual, and healthily bicurious white women, and even those white women with she/they in their bios who still identify as cis women have all become captivated by the sensible shoe craze.

But to simply don these comfy footwear only constitutes one half of the experience.  The crucial second component is the exhibition of such shoes to other white women in the near vicinity.  This is how the white woman builds community and, of course, through establishing whose footwear is indeed the most sensible, determines the alpha of the pack.

They were bought on sale, or better yet, thrifted, though she has the money to buy new.  She did not wash the previous owner’s foot sweat from the soles of those Tevas, because she feels that the mingling of their bodily fluids is a kind of intimate communion that intertwines their souls through soles.  She gave her entire gym athlete’s foot.

Lead scholars in the field of white woman studies have connected this alpha ritual to an ancient prophetic legend.  The prophecy foretells of a white woman with the most sensible shoes in the universe.  She wanders the globe with ne’er a blister, nor a callous, with arches high enough to shelter a small family of field mice.  According to legend, when this white woman emerges, chosen out of scores of sensibly shodden alpha white women, she will be the one to lead them all.

This rise is the sensible-shoed white woman can only signify one thing: they are preparing for war.  War against what, you ask?  War against the greatest injustice that has ever befallen the human race in the history of mankind: improper arch support.

So if you are a lover of flat-footed shoes like Vans or Chuck Taylors, or perhaps a little more dangerous as a wearer of platforms, wedges, or even stripper heels, beware; the white women are coming.  They are on a mission to save your feet from your hedonistic footwear and convert you to the sensible shoe gospel.  Your dogs have been warned.
articles.name: Emma Santos

articles.title: Why Did No One Tell Me the Woke Left
articles.description: Anyways. I have been sitting, coveredddddd in barbeque sauce for like 20 minutes patiently waiting for the woke mob to come get me
articles.content:
Why Did No One Tell Me the Woke Left


Dear Diary,

Today I couldn’t find my diary, so I’m writing this on both of my Kung Fu Panda 2 DVDs. Anyways. I have been sitting, coveredddddd in barbeque sauce for like 20 minutes patiently waiting for the woke mob to come get me. They love licking me clean.

We do this once a week every Thursday at 4:30. They love my barbeque sauce. I make it fresh every Thursday morning for them. I get soooooo excited on Thursdays even my roommates can see it! This morning I popped out of my bed and skipped over to the kitchen and my roommate went “hey um what are you wearing lol”. I went “my special barbeque sauce outfit for the woke!”, she went “what does that mean?”. I told her the story. I told her the origin story actually.

I told her how one day I was people watching in the commons. I told her I spilled a little of my fresh homemade barbeque sauce on me and like 10 wokes came to lick it clean. It was so fun and it felt nice. She said “you’re so fucking weird what the fuck” super judgmentally. It was kind of upsetting. Sad face. But no worries! I get to be licked so soon! I walk towards the door, but forget my goodbye kiss from my roommate, so I scurry back over to the kitchen and then after our five minute fiery passionate goodbye kiss, I walk out the door. I skip. I am practically floating on air. I sit on my park bench and I smotherrrrrrr myself in barbeque sauce.

I wait TEN minutes. No one. Not a soul comes to give me a lil lick. So there I am sat, covered in sauce that will seemingly never be licked off my body. I begin to believe I am the problem. Why does no one care about my body barbeque? I sit there thinking and I shed a tear. I check my phone to see what is popping on the Gram and I see that the woke left. Diary, this was the worst thing I could have seen. Not only were they not there to lick off my saucy saucy body today, but they never will be again. Times like these. They really make you think. Stay safe out there man you never know when the ones you love will leave.

XOXO,

Bbq girl <3

articles.title: The Cheese Gambit: Every time I Go to the Bathroom I Must Best A Little Mouse In A Game of Chess
articles.description: At this point, I know you, and you know me. And so you should know that I have celiac disease and cannot eat gluten. And that I’m Jewish.
articles.content:
The Cheese Gambit: Everytime I Go to the Bathroom I Must Best A Little Mouse In A Game of Chess

Hello readers. It’s me, Doran. I’m a junior at this university now. At this point, I know you, and you know me. And so you should know that I have celiac disease and cannot eat gluten. And that I’m Jewish. And that Jews frequently have digestive issues. Because of this, going to the bathroom is something very sacred to me. It’s a place where I can just sit in silence by myself and let loose. Let go of anything that’s holding me down, and just let it flow out of my body.

So you can imagine how fucking MAD I was when a little fucking know-it-all MOUSE stood blocking the fucking entrance with his stupid fucking chess board and little fucking mouse chess pieces fucking asking me to fucking play or he fucking wouldn’t fucking let fucking me fucking in to fucking shit! (Clearly, mad enough to let the God of middle school boys who just learned to curse take over me. His name is Jason. He’s actually lowkey a ki once you get to know him /srs)

How could this be happening to me? My shit is currently nudging against the interior of my asshole and this other asshole is making me sit down for a nice game of chess! Either way, I had no choice. I had to beat him. And so, I got to work, trying to ignore the reverse sodomy happening down below. Before I knew it, he had lost (of course, like how could I lose to a literal mouse), and I got to have my special time.

However, as I passed the mouse to go hit the pooper, I heard a little mischievous snicker, “You may have bested me today, but you’ll never finish the whole Cheese Gambit, muahahahaha!!!”

I for one, don’t take dumb shit like that (I let it go.) so I immediately yelled back, “The Cheese Gambit? Bitch you ain’t Anya Taylor-Joy, you could NEVER be Anya Taylor-Joy. Anya Taylor-Joy would never stop people from dropping deuces, she would respectfully wait for them to drop said deuce and then have a nice game of chess waiting for them when they’re DONE!”

The mouse gave me no response except for an impish chuckle, as he seemingly strolled away. I then had a very nice shit.

But the next day, he was there again. And the next, the one after that, and the following day. This continued for weeks, and there was nothing I could do about it. One day, the mouse laughed at me, saying, “oh you’re gonna tell on me? Hah! You think anyone would believe such a ridiculous story?”

“You’re right,” I said. “No one would believe I’m playing a little mouse in chess.”

“HAH! No! I meant, no one will believe that you’re beating me, fucko!”

This cycle continued for 40 days and 40 nights, the games getting harder each time, until one night, it wasn’t just him. 80s of mice sat behind him clapping their hands rhythmically as I walked up to the board to gain passage as he sat there with a crown of cheese on his head, opposing me.

“You have company this time. And a new hat,” I noticed.

The mice all abruptly stopped clapping, and he looked at me in shock.

“You do realize that every mouse you’ve played has been a different mouse, right? Like, I’ve never played you before. I’m the Cheese King, the best chess player in the land.”

I stared at my adversaries in shock of this news. I had no clue. But what I did know was that I had to shit reaaal bad. So I got to work again.

The game was intense. I almost lost. He was struggling. And each time he did, he would take a little nibble out of his crown. But right near the end, the spirit of Anya emboldened me to make the necessary decisions to come out victorious. I cheered. The mice cried. I had finally defeated these evil mice, and could now poop freely! The mice couldn’t believe it, and the Cheese King placed his crown on my head. I gladly accepted the honor, and continued passage into my safe space.

Eyes closed, taking it all in, I sat down on the toilet, hearing the cries of the mice outside.

“Hey hoststuff, need a hand?”

I turn and jump up in shock, the shit literally being scared out of me, as I see my best friend, Olga Syphil, sitting on a toilet facing me that I’ve never seen in my bathroom before in my life.

“Let’s drop that dookie together now, shall we? One, two, three, Squeeeeeze!”

articles.title: Since Hate Crimes Are Apparently Fine Now, Here’s How To Get Back At All Those People You Mildly Dislike
articles.description: If hate crimes are apparently fine now, what else can we get away with? As long as you can attribute your actions to being motivated by prejudice based on perceived membership in a social group, you should be in the clear.
articles.content:
It’s been over a month since the Center for Gender, Sexuality, and Activism was vandalized and ransacked. The perpetrator ripped down pride flags and destroyed political posters, targeting a space dedicated to protecting and supporting marginalized communities. In the face of this clear hate crime, the BU administration has, predictably, done nothing meaningful in the last 39 days.

However, this raises the question: If hate crimes are apparently fine now, what else can we get away with? As long as you can attribute your actions to being motivated by prejudice based on perceived membership in a social group, you should be in the clear. That guy who holds full 10-minute conversations with your professor in a 100-person lecture instead of just going to office hours? His last name is O’Neill–that sounds Irish enough, doesn’t it? That one acapella group you harbor slightly negative feelings about? All their members are women, and you’re sure that at least some of them get bisexual with it. Your butch, Chinese, just-cut-their-hair friend who won’t stop needling you with monkey facts and threatening to go on low-dose T? That’s your prime target, baby.

So, now that you’ve identified a target, what can you actually do?

Obviously, vandalism is a-okay. Feel free to break in and make a mess–throw furniture around, rip down decorations, ransack the fridge. If you’re feeling creative, you could spray paint a threatening message on the wall, or maybe just draw a dog or something. For our more minimalist readers, writing a short note or even just leaving something that looks out of place can be enough. Remember, your goal is to get your message across, though inducing a healthy amount of fear surely won’t hurt.

Honestly, thievery is probably fine too. Buttery-soft, perfectly oversized vintage leather jacket hanging in the closet? No one has insurance for personal belongings anyway, go ahead and take it! Does the club that rejected you always stock delicious snacks from H Mart? You deserve it more than them, and you’re prettier and smarter than them anyway.

Frankly, for the past month, our university administration has set a clear precedent that no consequences will be doled out to offenders, but ONLY IF the targets belong to marginalized and/or oppressed groups. Unfortunately, that means those white supremacists are probably a no-go, as are the campus Christian groups that love to stop you while you’re rushing to class.

As always, exercise caution, and use your own discretion. Be creative. The sky is your limit. Now go get ‘em, champ!

articles.title: Dear Seniors: Only 3 More Weekends to Quit Your College Alcoholic Tendencies
articles.description: Say yes to Senior Spring! Except like. Hey. This is an intervention. You say yes every chance you get. You have been slightly tipsy for the past 12 weeks. You have a problem.
articles.content:
Say yes to Senior Spring! Except like. Hey. This is an intervention. You say yes every chance you get. You have been slightly tipsy for the past 12 weeks. You have a problem.

But hey! We aren’t here to judge or make jokes about alcoholism. It is super serious, and you should never be afraid to ask for help. For the sake of this article, however, you are not technically an alcoholic. You’re just in college.

As the semester comes to an end and you gear up to put on that bright Boston University Red robe, you have got to make every last drink count. You have to get it together. Face reality: You don’t need the drunk ciggies. You’re going to end up getting hooked, and let’s be serious, you are too young and far too privileged to have to take advantage of smoke breaks at work. What you need is a juice box and time outside, watching the blades of grass sway in the wind.

 

You don’t need to drink before everything… But it sure is fun! Anything can be pre-gamed if you believe in it hard enough. So make sure to pregame your last classes and club meetings. You can take a shot right before Senior breakfast. Hell, bring a borg to commencement!

But make sure that when you wake up on Monday, May 19th, preparing to drag a yellow cart through the halls of your dorm or end up stuck in traffic with your entire family as you prepare to drive for hours, those tendencies are out of your system. You will no longer have the urge to mix vodka with any non alcoholic beverage you can find. You will no longer lose count of how many shots you’ve taken during a night out. You are an adult and you have only so many years left on your parents’ health insurance, and getting your stomach pumped is not cheap.

For these next three weekends, make sure you are getting as white boy wasted, Channing Tatum, as is possible (Megan Thee Stallion reference). But be mindful about it. Understand that this is the peak. Life gets worse after this. So let’s get crazy crazy crazy till we see the sun… I know we only met, but let’s pretend it’s love… and never never never stop for anyone… tonight let’s get some, and live while we’re young (One Direction reference).

articles.title: Going Undercover To Find BU Understall
articles.description: Tonight I will kill BU Understall.
articles.content:
It was stormy on that fateful night on Boston University’s campus. The rain was pounding against my battered Converse, the water leaving my socks the exact same way I was when I first saw Jacob Elordi in Saltburn:

        Soaking wet.

        But I can’t give up yet.

        Tonight was the night I was going to find him.

        Tonight I will kill BU Understall.

        He’s been a menace towards me and my friends for too long now. Constantly tapping my friends and spamming “Hey” every evening at 7:08 PM. His agenda to commit fellatio under the unwashed walls of  a Warren Towers bathroom stall will NOT happen on my watch.

        His reign of terror will end tonight.

        I devised my plan as I made my way up the Warren Escalators, I’d use my fake account on Grindr to lure the monster out of his goon cave. We knew he lived in Warren, that’s where he liked to work. Maybe the allure from a blurry photo of David Hasselhoff from the 2005 Spongebob Movie would be enough to trick the demon into meeting me… understall.

        My phone pinged. A notification from him on Grindr.

        On My Way!

        This fuckass bitch. He probably typed omw and it autocorrected.

        I took a deep breath and waited outside of the men’s bathroom. I couldn’t go in first because I needed the element of surprise, I needed BU Understall to strike first.

        It happened in a blur.

        The elevator chimed. Indicating that it’s arrived on the fourth floor.

        He’s here.

        A shadowy figure makes its way out of the doors. His broad shoulders filled up the elevator doors with ease. I couldn’t make out his face, as he was wearing a black hoodie that concealed his true identity.

        Soon the strange stench filled the air, the smell of lubriderm and desperation felt like assault on my poor nostrils. The lights flickered as it lumbered towards the bathroom. The building quivered as the cheap linoleum flooring shattered under BU Understall’s weight.

        It opened the door to the bathroom and strutted right in. Whistling a jolly tune as it prepared to make love to David Hasselhoff.

        I took another deep breath. It was time. I opened the door and made my way into the dungeon.

        The bathroom was shrouded in a mist one could only describe as a Geek Bar. The nicotine fog eased my senses as I made my way to the stall. I kicked down the door, expecting to see the gooner for once and for all.

        But he was not there. No one was there.

        He found a way out. Likely by flushing himself down the toilet like the rats in Flushed Away. But there was something left on the wall… a note.

                Meet me on the 4th floor Mugar bathroom. Bring poppers. - BU U

Something tells me that this is only the beginning to the story of BU Understall.

STAY TUNED FOR NEXT YEARS STORY:

“Going Undercover To Find BU Understall Part Two: The Bi-Curious BioMed Bathroom Bator”

articles.title: You’re Celebrating Marmon This Week, I’m Celebrating The “In russia doing research.” 16th Anniversary (April 25, 2009 @ 9:35am)
articles.description: When I pitched this headline to The Pinky Toe, I was shocked when nobody, in a room CHOCK FULL of GAY PEOPLE, got the reference. Not a ONE. I will say, I did happen to pitch on the one day that The Pinky Toe’s foremost Lady Gaga fan was absent. But either way, SOMEBODY should have known. Needless to say, I was disappointed.
articles.content:
So I did in fact also celebrate Marmon. We really had a triple? Quadruple? Quintuple? Whammy of a long weekend. To have Easter and 4/20 fall on the same day was just magical! I don’t personally celebrate much in the way of Easter but it was fun trying to guess who was celebrating what. I spent a beautiful day in the Commons, indulging in the devil’s lettuce and some truly DELECTABLE Dave’s Hot Chicken. Then I ended the day off at the Lucy Dacus concert--maybe magic is real!! The tale of my Marmon begins on Thursday night when I, having finally been released from the shackles of my fast food job at 10pm, kicked things off with a beautiful Thirsty Thursday game night. And we stayed strong, persevering beyond all odds to maintain a wonderful 5 day Marmon bender. Now I know what you’re thinking, but this is NOT!!!! Alcoholism. A Boston college student’s very first Marmon is something to be celebrated. And celebrate I did!

But all of that Marmon business aside, today I am celebrating the highest holiday of them all. Today, April 25, 2025, at 9:35am, is the 16th anniversary of “In russia doing research.” When I pitched this headline to The Pinky Toe, I was shocked when nobody, in a room CHOCK FULL of GAY PEOPLE, got the reference. Not a ONE. I will say, I did happen to pitch on the one day that The Pinky Toe’s foremost Lady Gaga fan was absent. But either way, SOMEBODY should have known. Needless to say, I was disappointed. But this only goes to show, I need to do my job, I need to put in the work, and spread the Gaga gospel.

Today we celebrate, we honor, we revere Miss Queen Germanotta.

What is perhaps one of the most influential and life altering pieces of internet history is Lady Gaga’s 2009 (specifically April 25 at 9:35am) tweet which simply states, “In russia doing research.” It leaves many questions to be asked. Gaga, what are you researching? Gaga, why are you in Russia? Okay so maybe it only leaves two questions to be asked. And though I am a person of great scientific inquiry skills, who puzzles, questions, makes connections, and investigates, I really couldn’t answer these questions for you! And I KNOW the people (gay) desperately want, desperately need to know the answers--but Gaga’s glamour, mystery, and intrigue keep those answers from us! I don’t know if she’ll ever let us in on her little secret. I can only hope and dream that one day she’ll spill the beans--but I doubt that day is coming any time soon.

So until then, I’ll be in russia doing research.

articles.title: Cory Booker, What Else Can That Mouth Do for 25 Hours
articles.description: For my last ever article for The Pinky Toe before I graduate and return to my parent’s house, I thought it would be best to write about my hometown honey Cory Booker. As a New Jersey native, I’ve always had a bald spot for him. Or is it a soft spot?
articles.content:
For my last ever article for The Pinky Toe before I graduate and return to my parent’s house, I thought it would be best to write about my hometown honey Cory Booker. As a New Jersey native, I’ve always had a bald spot for him. Or is it a soft spot?

There has always been something so attractive to me about Cory Booker. My crush started when I heard him speak at Ketanji Brown Jackson’s confirmation hearing. He was so passionate and wouldn’t shut up to the point that it felt like mansplaining. And I needed that. So when I heard that my beloved state senator spoke for 25 hours on the Senate floor, I got the ick. But everyone gets and gives the ick.

Because my attention span is fried, I watched the last three minutes of his speech since that’s all the time he’d need with me anyway. Just from watching those three minutes, he checks all the boxes of a man written by a woman. His broad shoulders and sounding like he’s always on the brink of tears really get the jets going. Based on simple logic, someone who can move their mouth and spread their vocal folds for 25 hours straight is a certified munch. It’s a crime that this man is both RuPaul’s cousin and currently single.

If you’re reading this Mr. Senator, just know that we can get into some good trouble as you put it. We can FiliBUST all night. In the words of former Trump supporter Azealia Banks, I guess that cunt gettin eat’n.

articles.content:
As the trees begin to bloom and bushes of all types begin to grow outside their bounds, like-minded hotdogs and people across Boston are wondering what to do on a warm (40 degree) sunny (sometimes that cloud moves away) Saturday afternoon (it's a Tuesday night). Well, thanks to the Trump administration banning the word women, it is back to the basics: men and hotdogs. So this season, sit right down and prepare for not the worst time during your week: the new 24 hour challenge meme challenge funny hot dog challenge to do with friends and other hotdogs.

To host a N24HCMCFHDCTDWFAOH, first gather your friends or hotdogs. For your friends, you may try creating a silly Canva invite using canva.com and your BU email. No, you don’t have Canva Pro, but you still have a vast selection of hotdog imagery to entice your friends. If it is instead other hotdogs you are trying to kindle a friendship with, it is more effective to hire a local dog to herd the hotdogs into formation to attend your event. Local hotdog herding dog services cannot be found on canva, but rather hotdoghunters.org on which BU emails do in fact have a premium account.

After you have a rough guest list for your N24HCMCFHDCTDWFAOH event, it's time to get into the funny meme challenge hassle of it all. It's easy to be funny, but the challenge part of this event is not easy to pull off. Begin by lubricating your home depot buckets with the hotdog water. Remember, the most sanitary measure for cooking your hotdogs is to make a vertical incision, place the weenie in a shallow plate of water, and microwave for 1-2:30 minutes. This method not only heats the weenie to the perfect meme-ing temperature but also infuses the water with the rich hotdog nutrients necessary to replenish the lost enzymes as your guest hotdogs and friends alike will suffer great physical exertion.

Once the buckets are adequately lined with hotdog waters and microwaves weenies, gather your guests around the bucket… the fun is about to begin. Alert your guests of the nearest exits in case of emergency, go over the rules and regulations of safe sex and drug use, and finally, remind guests about the plights of plagiarism as explained in the BU student handbook, all with at least 3 hotdogs adhered to somewhere on your body. This makes it look easy, but you must've used tape! Aha, it will be much harder for your guests to replicate this here trick.

Now it's their turn! See how many hotdogs your hotdogs and friends can balance on their bodies!

Yes, it’s that easy. It seems crazy that such a funny and laughing challenge could require four paragraphs of buildup and instruction, however, this challenge is bound to make memories lasting years. Stand perfectly still and try not to laugh… play some timely hits to get people happy… try out Má Vlast (My Country): No 2 Vltava [Moldau] by Bedřich Smetana, Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra and Antoni Wit. If that's not for you, Turn My Swag On by Soulja Boy will certainly take this challenge to the next meme level, though you may sacrifice some aura points and cringe levels. This can all be redacted by throwing a T-pose into the mix, making the balancing of hotdogs all the more difficult.

If you enjoy this activity, be sure to follow Pinky Toe on all platforms to stay updated on other funny meme challenges that everyone is doing and laughing at while doing and other hotdog events and information.

But be careful, hotdogs can be deadly. Though ideally, you provide alternative snacks instead of eating your hotdog guests, it is a known fact that each hotdog consumed by a human cuts 36 minutes off their lives. Sure, this is all fun and games, but the hotdog 24 hour silly challenge is an important lesson in healthy diet and limiting hotdog intake in the face of Trump's dramatic defunding of other carcinogens. As it becomes increasingly hard to buy indie Chinese cigarettes or cancerous Mongolian chicken nuggets because of Trump’s outrageous tariffs, it is important to be aware of the domestic health possibilities provided by our very own hotdogs.

articles.title: The Subtle Art of Getting Old Men Online to Gift you Convenience Points
articles.description: Picture me– in bed. I haven’t washed my bedding in months. Boston University is bleeding me dry, and each day I find myself caught between a rock (laundry) and a hard place (chai latte). The choice is obvious. I get a ding on my phone.
articles.content:
Picture me– in bed. I haven’t washed my bedding in months. Boston University is bleeding me dry, and each day I find myself caught between a rock (laundry) and a hard place (chai latte). The choice is obvious. I get a ding on my phone.

“Ding!” it dings.

Picture me– in bed. This old man who just followed me on Instagram certainly is. Probably a scammer. Maybe true love. Possibly a lonely, independently wealthy soul looking to spend the rest of his days financially supporting someone who exclusively posts pictures of herself in sunglasses and seasonally-inappropriate layers of clothing.

After methodically liking each and every single one of my posts, the man (Kenneth) sends a message. Hello dearest beautiful. I would like to get to know you and send allowance of 300$ monthly.

Well, that sounds good to me. I send back a classic, tasteful back-of-knee fake cleavage pic. We don’t use AI for our catfishing around here. We do it purely for the love of the game.

He responds, Beautiful send routing number and account number.

Not so fast Kenneth. Now if I'm to sell my body (knee), I’ll do it for the currency that I damn please. The one that best suits my current, desperate need for laundry money.

Convenience points.

Luckily the BU gifting system makes it easy, dare I say convenient, to get “parents, family, and friends” to digitally send you money in the form of convenience points. I’d say Kenneth is eligible.

Unfortunately, the next step requires giving Kenneth my BUID. But what’s the worst he can do? Turn in my missing assignments on Blackboard? Pay my 6-months-overdue fall tuition balance? Use Handshake™ to schedule a zoom call with my advisor? If that's what’s getting him off, hey… Kenneth is welcome to do all of the above.

I ponder how much money he’ll send over. Will he stick to our agreed upon 300? Give me a little extra to save for a rainy day? Or maybe he’ll appreciate the boldness of my fake cleavage picture and pick the auto-select option of 1500$.

You know, a normal amount to be transferred anonymously from someone’s bank account to cold, hard convenience points. Now, while I’m firmly a lifestyle columnist and have no interest in investigative journalism, I have a strange feeling that students' clothes aren’t the only things being laundered here….

But hey, that’s besides the point. Why shouldn’t a loving, wealthy parent or a strange digital old man give me 1500$ to use on overpriced vending machines, broken laundry machines, and CityCo sushi?

I’m getting ahead of myself. With only minor hesitation, I send the gifting link and my BUID number to Kenneth, awaiting the days ahead. Days full of fresh linens, chai lattes, and joy.

articles.title: Cancel Short King Spring, They Don’t Deserve It
articles.description: P.S. This article was inspired by and written for a friend who has been wronged by a short man one too many times
articles.content:
Short King Spring is Cancelled

Spring has finally sprung in Boston, and with it, so have the short Boston men. Five-seven kings everywhere are coming out of hibernation to be your next toxic situationship. With romance and pollen in the air, normally, this is their chance to shine. I’m here to tell you that short king spring is cancelled. Let’s be honest, these guys don't deserve it.

Why are you gonna give that frat guy standing on a chair the time of day? He thinks he’s hot shit breathing in the air up there for once or something. These guys are busy packing all their anger and manipulation into their little bodies, but it doesn’t fit, so you get the brunt of it. When you give these guys a chance, they don’t realize how lucky they are; you feed their little egos and make them think they deserve someone out of their league. It’s time to come to your senses, people! Stop looking down!

To the short kings out there, it’s time to bring those shoe inserts back out. This political climate is no time to be embracing your god-given stature. It’s time for all of you to learn what it’s like without all the pity and charity. Maybe this will teach you the lesson you need to finally get an attitude that compensates for a couple of inches. Until then, we expect to be left alone while you scurry around like ants during marmon or in your frat basement while you’re busy breaking your neck looking up at the rest of the brothers.

This is a movement to make the world a better place for everyone. Stand your ground, and we can be the change we want to see in the world. It’s time to develop some self-respect and stop deluding short men into thinking they deserve anything.

P.S. This article was inspired by and written for a friend who has been wronged by a short man one too many times <3

articles.title: This White Ass Bar Got Me Feeling Like Grammy Award Winning Musician Alessia Cara
articles.description: You know what? I’m not sorry if I seem uninterested. Or I’m not listening. Or I’m indifferent. Because truly I ain’t got no business here, but since my friends are here, I just came to kick it. Or at least I attempted to.
articles.content:
You know what? I’m not sorry if I seem uninterested. Or I’m not listening. Or I’m indifferent. Because truly I ain’t got no business here, but since my friends are here, I just came to kick it. Or at least I attempted to.

Boston, Massachusetts does not have many good things going for it at the moment. The weather sucks, the captain of their hockey team got traded, and —worst of all— the nightlife is atrocious. Which brings us back to this white ass bar and me, someone who is famously not white.

Going nonverbal is an understatement. I’m trying very hard to develop superpowers in order to hide in the walls. But also… if one more slightly balding student athlete who isn’t even going to make it to the league bumps into me, I may have to develop superpowers to explode him with my mind.

I know we all made fun of Alessia Cara for making what was once described as an anthem for introverts, but have we never once considered that she was tapping into the oppression she faced as a light-skinned passing Italian? Like, they literally stuck ol’ girl in a function where she couldn’t kick it and just listen to some music with the message like she usually does.

So as bottle blondes blatantly step in front of me at the bar to try and score free drinks from the guy who routinely cheats on his girlfriend while Tate McRae blasts from the speakers on what is supposed to be “Afro-House” night, I understand Ms. Caracciolo more and more.

And while I’m not congregating next to the refrigerator, some girl is definitely talking ‘bout her haters but she ain’t got none! Except, she does now. It’s me. There’s something rushing through my veins that’s making me volatile, so unlike the boy who’s throwing up cause he can’t take what’s in his cup no more, the whiskey sour in my hands is making me thisss close to putting my hands on someone. Just because I’m an (alleged) pacifist does not mean I’m unwilling to pass a fist.

articles.title: Mass Gen Brigham Misgendered Me After I Came to the ER Drunk on St Patrick’s Day
articles.description: This past St. Patrick’s Day, I (M20, cis, straight) experienced discrimination to a degree I never had before. Frankly, I’m very disappointed in the staff at Mass General Hospital, who I still owe 2,250 dollars. Yes, that’s right. Despite having iron clad insurance (Student plan \*basic), I somehow owe the hospital for my troubles.
articles.content:
This past St. Patrick’s Day, I (M20, cis, straight) experienced discrimination to a degree I never had before. Frankly, I’m very disappointed in the staff at Mass General Hospital, who I still owe 2,250 dollars. Yes, that’s right. Despite having iron clad insurance (Student plan basic), I somehow owe the hospital for my troubles. But to tell you, dear reader, how I decided to embrace Irish culture and drink till I woke up in Baskin Robbins, we must return to the night before…

The night before the big day, one of my best lads and I made the arduous journey to Star Market to buy a jug of water for some whimsical brewing. Now I know what you’re thinking: “Ugh, another person at the St. Patty’s day parade with a borg, how original.” First of all, what are you? The fucking Orange Order? Second, please do not belittle my amazing freedom juice to a borg. No, I created a potion, a mixture of rare liquids to replenish and fuel the body: 2 bottles of orange Powerade, redbull, and enough vodka to kill an English baby. As for the decorations, My glorious chalice of orange elixir was to be adorned with many classic Irish symbols: A leprechaun, a casket with Queen Elizabeth and Margaret Thatcher painted on it, and the title of the borg itself: “The Cran-Borg-ies.” Yes, I was about to let this borg linger all over Boston’s South End with the might of 1000 IRA patriots. I put my clothes out for tomorrow, a Celtic (the Football (soccer) team) jersey, jeans, and converse. I said one “Our Father,” reminded myself of my he/him pronouns, and fell asleep watching Derry Girls.

I woke up the next morning feeling properly Catholic, so I put on as many green things as I owned and a rosary for luck. Little did I know I was gonna need so much more than the luck of a four leaf clover. A few pre games, rattling bogs, and splitting the G’s later, I found myself in the South End. And you know what? I had been sooooo good the rest of the semester. Hey, I had cut down on my drinking down to about one rager per week, I stopped smoking 30%+ THC weed, and I hadn’t had a cig in like 4 days. I know I know, health influencer in the making, I’m just waiting for those brand deals to start rolling in. But I deserved to have a cheat day. And what better day to let your ginger locks down and sing “Come out ye black and tans” than St. Pattys. Everything was good, just chugging along at my borg until…

DISASTER!!

I woke up in a hospital bed. NOOOOOOOO! CURSE THE CROWN!!!!! How could this happen… How did this happen…Why am I so groggy?

I looked around at whoever was near me and saw one of my friends telling me that I was too drunk. I DEMANDED to leave. “Let me leave, let me leave” I said in a (no joke) Irish accent. Yeah I know you’re trying it for yourself right now, it’s not good but mine was worse. I was in utter disbelief of my situation. The doctor patted my arm as she told me “You thought you were in a Baskin Robbins 10 minutes ago.” Now there's an idea Doc, get one of the nurses to run out for a double scoop of mint chip on the double. I then went to do the next most important thing: access my phone. I could’ve called a trusted adult or friend, but what did I do? I went on reels for a sec just to get a little bump. My day had been absolutely shot, so I needed a little dopamine hit. After watching Irish unification propaganda for about 5 minutes, the doctor came back. But in my mind, it was an Englishman coming to take away my freedom. “I can't talk! I'm in my pub!” I yelled as I drew the covers way over my head. I did that repeatedly for about 20 more minutes, before I fell asleep again in the fetal position.

This just couldn’t be real. “Stupid, stupid, stupid!” I said to myself in bed. But there was no time to wallow in my pain. My mind immediately started racing as to what I needed to do to get the FUCK out of there. Like beloved Irishman Cillian Murphy did in Oppenheimer, I devised an explosive plan to burst out and never have to pay a hospital bill. I left my beloved blanket pub and sprung up. Think, think… Phone wallet keys! Wallet? Still in my orange puke-stained pocket. Keys? Yup, still on my carabiner (maybe this gave them the wrong idea…) And phone? In my hand, not playing reels, 0% battery. Problem. I became Matt Damon in The Martian: determined to survive and get the fuck back home by any means necessary.

If you’re still reading, congratulations, and as a reward you’re in for the best part of the story. I have to stress that the following is actually true. I looked at my surroundings to find a solution to my “dead phone” problem. My bed was positioned next to the nurses’ desk, where conveniently there was a phone charging on the desk. Ba-Fucking-zinga, salvation. I unplugged that poor nurse’s phone and plugged mine in. What a fucking saint, this guy right? Unplugging first responders’ phones just to watch reels has to be unethical. To that, I say if they can call my medical bill ethical, then I can use their fucking phone charger. I’m a philosophy major btw so just trust me on this one.

After playing Brawl Stars and texting back all my anxious friends, I yelled for the nurse, asking to be discharged. She did a couple more tests on me, and then I walked out. FREEDOM!!! My Bloody Sunday had become a Good Friday and I was again a free man. Hospital notes in hand, dried up vomit on my shirt. As I T’d my way back to my dorm, I looked at my hospital notes to see if there was anything important in there. Blah blah blah social security number bleh bleh insurance number. After I got all the boilerplate stuff out of the way, I got to my hospital notes and noticed something so shocking I audibly gasped.

Age: 20 Height: 5’8 Weight: 155 lbs Pronouns: They/Them

WHAT THE FUCK???????

articles.title: Happy Autism Acceptance Month: A List of 10 Famous Autistic People Who Have Never Accidentally Saluted Hitler
articles.description: Happy Autism Acceptance Month for all those autistic baddies out there, undiagnosed queens, and their undiagnosed moms in denial!  We here at the Pinky Toe are celebrating some celebrities who you may not know are autistic and have also never accidentally saluted Hitler.  Many of these celebrities have many other notable accomplishments, and not saluting Hitler is typically not recognized as an accomplishment, but rather the standard.  However, recent events have lowered the bar to levels so unimaginably low, the bar had to be reinforced so the heat of the Earth’s core would not melt it.
articles.content:
Happy Autism Acceptance Month for all those autistic baddies out there, undiagnosed queens, and their undiagnosed moms in denial!  We here at the Pinky Toe are celebrating some celebrities who you may not know are autistic and have also never accidentally saluted Hitler.  Many of these celebrities have many other notable accomplishments, and not saluting Hitler is typically not recognized as an accomplishment, but rather the standard.  However, recent events have lowered the bar to levels so unimaginably low, the bar had to be reinforced so the heat of the Earth’s core would not melt it.

 

1. Bella Ramsey

 

Actor, queer icon, autistic.  Bella Ramsey is many things, but one thing you’ll find missing from this list is Nazi-sympathizer.  While they have opened up about their recent autism diagnosis, it appears that no spontaneous Nazi saluting followed their diagnosis. 

 

2. Dan Aykroyd

 

Everyone’s favorite Ghostbuster has often credited his diagnosis of Asperger’s (now referred to as simply another form of Autism Spectrum Disorder) with his successful acting career.  While he has made comedies involving Nazis (notably as the bad guys) he has never saluted Hitler.

 

3. Greta Thunberg

 

Remember that Swedish bitch that you all thought was super inspiring but forgot about once you realized how annoying paper straws were?  She is also autistic, and while she frequently stands on stage and speaks to large audiences from a podium, she has never once saluted Hitler from that podium.  She’s still rather young though, she still has a long life ahead of her to experiment with hate-speech.

 

4. Kermit the Frog

 

All of the other celebrities on this list have confirmed that they are autistic, but I felt that Kermit should be included because…well, just look at him.  A pillar of success for the autistic community.  And while I don’t believe we should be speculated about people’s diagnoses when we don’t know the whole story of their lives, I think we can say with fair certainty that Kermit is autistic, even if he hasn’t come out publicly as neurodivergent yet.  Kermit the Frog has never saluted the Nazis, and if he did, the very fabric of our society would be torn apart and nothing would ever be good again.

5. Courtney Love

 

Multi-talented singer/songwriter/guitarist/rock-and-roll goddess Courtney Love is as cool as a certain fascist wannabe space cowboy wishes he was.  She was diagnosed with autism as a child, and has managed to go her entire life without accidentally saluting Hitler.

 

6. Sia

 

It may surprise you to know that the pop artist known for always hiding her face in public recently found out she was on the spectrum.  While she has done some controversial things in her career (and I don’t just mean that fuckass bow that makes her look like Jojo Siwa on shrooms), saluting the Third Reich is not one of them.

7. Susan Boyle

 

You may remember Susan Boyle for her viral performance singing “I Dreamed A Dream” from Les Mis.  What you won't remember her for is saluting the Nazi party, which she hasn’t done.

 

8. Chloé Hayden

 

Actress and activist Chloé Hayden began on Youtube and has risen to stardom with her role on Netflix’s reboot of Heartbreak High.  In the midst of all her newfound fame, she has somehow managed to resist the trap of accidentally supporting neo-naziism.

9. Grimes

Yes, the Grimes that was married to that fuckstick and had his children.  Grimes has revealed that she was recently diagnosed with autism.  Despite also having autism, it appears her ex-husband’s affiliation for Nazi Germany era traditions did not rub off on her.

 

10. Anthony Hopkins

 

Anthony Hopkins doesn’t technically belong on this list, given the fact that he did indeed win an Emmy in 1981 for the historical film The Bunker, where he played, you guessed it, Hitler!  But I still had to put him on here because he’s a very accomplished autistic actor and, dare I say, iconic?  Have you ever seen a cannibal slay harder than him in Silence of the Lambs—I am still screaming, Clarice!  So while he has “technically” embodied Hitler, he still makes it onto this list, because his artistic portrayal of Ol’ Short-stache is where his affinity ended.

 

In conclusion, while there has been much speculation in the media in the past few months that autism can cause sudden bursts of Nazi sympathizing, I hope this list serves as evidence that these claims are, to use the proper industry term, bullshit.  There are lots of autistic people out in the world doing amazing things.  So this Autism Acceptance Month (also known as Autism Awareness month, but shit, you haven’t heard about it already?) let’s spend time advocating for the autistic community and celebrating the people in it who are killing it, not platforming the 2020s’ most famous douchebag and using his autism as an excuse for what is simply a reflection of his vile, heartless personality.  I leave you with this: Hopkins could easily play a spoiled billionaire babyman, but Elon Musk could never play Hannibal Lector.

articles.title: I Lived It: Fit Mogged by Mayor Wu at St. Patrick’s Day Parade
articles.description:
After a T ride so hellish I just about opened up a transfer application at Hynes Convention 
Center, my friends and I made it to Park Street and headed towards the Red line. Once my friends and I made it to the right station, I looked up at the sea of people waiting for the train and audibly gulped.
articles.content:
Yes, I’m an Earth sign. No, I don't wear green. We exist.

So, retrospectively, maybe the St. Patrick’s Day parade wasn’t the ideal function for me. But I put forth my best effort anyway in the name of The Cranberries. I found a shirt that’s lowkey blue and practiced my gaslighting in the mirror just in case anyone asked me about it on the road. I’d convince innocent strangers that they’re color blind if that’s what it took to attend this parade. “THAT was for Ireland,” I’d say under my breath as I walked away.

After a T ride so hellish I just about opened up a transfer application at Hynes Convention Center, my friends and I made it to Park Street and headed towards the Red line. Once my friends and I made it to the right station, I looked up at the sea of people waiting for the train and audibly gulped.

I’d made a grave mistake.

I am actually the only person in history who doesn’t own a St. Patty’s Day T-shirt in Boston, Massachusetts. Potentially in the Northeast. I couldn’t believe it. Did I miss a meeting? An email? Was it in the GroupMe? When did we all collectively decide that we were taking St. Patty’s Day seriously? I thought it was just the Irish and McDonald’s who were doing all that. It’s not a MAJOR holiday.

Fit mogged by an entire train. I felt sick. This is probably how they felt during the potato famine, only much worse and infinitely more serious.

At the parade, the situation only grew more dire. As the marching bands passed, I devolved into a state of bargaining. Hey, why didn’t anyone let me know the theme was green lowkey? Shady as hell. Here I was thinking that we were friends, and then everyone shows up to the function having VERY CLEARLY discussed dress code beforehand. Oh, so this was happening in the group chat I’m not in? Classic. And on the day of the Irish, too. It’s downright cruel, if you ask me.

To make myself feel calmer and better instantaneously, I opened Instagram.

There it was. My last straw.

Why is Mayor Wu wearing lobster Nikes on my timeline?

Oh, she devoured me. Her fit went so hard, it felt personal. Emerald green dress and white to orange ombre sneakers to imitate the Irish flag in a subtle, yet self-aware fashion.

I couldn’t even be mad. The worst part was that it was all my own fault. My karmic balance doesn't hold a candle to Mayor Wu’s. My chances were slim to begin with, and I dropped the ball. It was over before it even began – I was fit mogged.

After the events of this March, I will never be showing my face at a St. Patrick’s Day function again. I hope that’s okay with everyone. No worries if not.

To anyone reading this, please, I implore you – Depop one item of green clothing right now. After all, you never know whether or not your mayor’s Pinterest board is absolute flames.

articles.title: “Su**er Int*****ip" and Other Slurs You Shouldn’t Be Saying
articles.description: Your tombstone reads: “Here lies a BU student. Taken too soon by career readiness.”
articles.content:
Summer Internship Trauma

You’re on the phone with your mom. You love your mom. She’s telling you how much she misses you, how she can’t wait to have you home for the summer. Your younger siblings will be pissed, but who cares? They deal with Mom and Dad all year. You? You’re about to return as the prodigal child, welcomed back with home-cooked meals and parents ready to grovel at your every request. Ah, the perks of being the sibling in college.

But then the conversation shifts. Your mom starts talking about… plans. Plans that don’t involve rotting in bed all summer. Gulp. She mentions her friend Andy. Andy has a firm. Andy needs help. Unpaid help. And then. She says it. “You know, you really need to find a SUMMER INTERNSHIP.”

The phone drops from your hand. Mouth agape. Body trembling. How could your mom drop that SLUR so casually??? Has she learned nothing? You thought people could change. But no. Your own mother just dropped the most offensive phrase known to college students. Wow. How dare she?

You think your day couldn’t possibly get worse. You head to a film class lecture because let's be real, how many people reading this article aren’t FTV majors? Then. It happens again.

Your professor stands at the front of class, saying he has something important to bring up about… opportunities for students. You ease back a little into your chair. It’s probably about extra credit before the semester ends. But then, you see it. The dreaded “S” sound forming on his lips. The devious glint in his eye. He’s about to say it. “SUMMER INTERNSHIPS are hard to find, but I know many small film directors who need help on set.”

You stand up in your chair, appalled. Aghast. Is this allowed??? Bring back WOKE and DEI because this professor has clearly gone insane! Spewing slurs left and right in front of a college class and calling it networking!!!???

It’s honestly ridiculous. You sprint out of the lecture hall, panting, heart racing. You fumble for your phone like it’s a life raft. You need TikTok. You need it now. But then you see it. An email. From your official BU advisor. Subject line: SUMMER INTERNSHIP ideas.

GAHHHHH. A sharp pain radiates through your chest. Your vision blurs. This is it, the final straw. The slur… it’s going to kill you.

You collapse onto COM lawn. Bystanders look on in horror. A freshman, young and untainted by these woes, whispers, “Oh my god, another one. That’s the third this week.” The campus EMTs arrive. The waft resumes under your nose to try and shake you out of it. They remind you of how many juicy LinkedIn connections are waiting for you.

“Experience is experience!” they shout as you flatline. But it’s too late. You’ve heard the word one too many times. Your soul lifts peacefully from your body as you drift into the unknown.

Your tombstone reads: “Here lies a BU student. Taken too soon by career readiness.”
